Friend, As we continue our journey toward the crucial election year of 2024, your steadfast support remains invaluable to our mission. We extend our deepest gratitude for your early backing in our campaign to propel Gloria Johnson as our next United States Senator from Tennessee! Gloria firmly believes in the power of grassroots movements and recognizes that your involvement is pivotal in driving the change we aspire to see. We cordially invite you to join us for our upcoming Tennessee Women Rising Zoom meeting scheduled for May 3rd, 2024, starting at 11:30 AM CST / 12:30 PM EST. This monthly gathering provides a platform for you to connect directly with Team Gloria and fellow supporters. Share your insights, pose questions, and engage in discussions that shape the future we envision. Here's how you can participate and contribute right now:
* Register for the Event: Secure your spot by registering for the May 3rd meeting using this link: https://us06web.zoom.us/meeting/register/tZYud-ihqzwvGtBJ2pBdPg8W6CI6lLR--2Jm
* Spread the Word: Help us expand our network by inviting friends, family, and colleagues who share our dedication to democracy and women's rights. Feel free to forward this email to them and encourage them to join us in this important endeavor.
* Contribute to Our Campaign: Your support fuels our momentum and drives positive change in Tennessee. Consider making a difference by inviting 10 friends to invest $100 each or by donating 10 hours of volunteer time.

We appreciate your unwavering support and dedication to democracy. Together, we can make a meaningful impact and pave the way for a brighter future. With gratitude,
TN Women Rising - for Gloria Johnson

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: I was asked to pass this on to you
body:
She’s asking for your help, Pro-Life Friend...

Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I just got off the phone with one of our Regional Coordinators from Arizona, and she asked me to pass a very important message onto you before the end of the morning!

I’ll need to give you a little backstory on her before I share with you what she said . . .

But before I do that, can you please do a huge favor for me?

**[Can I count on you to at least consider giving generously to take advantage of the $200,000 Matching Challenge we have going on right now](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltitjk-duchtdja-y/)?**

Pro-Life Friend, “meet” Heather Litchfield.

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltitjk-duchtdja-j/) Heather grew up in Prescott, Arizona and recently graduated from _Northern Arizona University._

She joined the Pro-Life Movement when she was a freshman in college, helping to revive the _Students for Life_ group on her campus, which kicked off her love for advocacy.

Heather now serves in Arizona, Utah, and Hawaii as _Students for Life Action’s_ Pacific Southwest Regional Coordinator!

Her work for us includes educating and training students about abortion, rapidly responding to pro-abortion events, organizing pro-life events and fundraisers, and canvassing/door-knocking.

In fact, Heather was featured for her incredible canvassing work in a recent article of the _New York Times_ where she sounded off on weak-kneed Republicans in Arizona, saying:

_"If you’re going to claim to be pro-life, you have to be pro-life all the time, not just when it suits your political aims."_
The Republicans she’s talking about _– such as U.S. Senate Candidate Kari Lake –_ have been trying to walk back the Abortion Prevention Law that the Arizona Supreme Court affirmed in a huge decision just a few weeks ago.

Now because of their cowardice, a radical Abortion Referendum will be on Arizona’s ballot this November, which would nullify the current Law if passed.

Helping convince Arizonans to VOTE NO on this extreme referendum is why Heather was out canvassing in the first place.

**And it’s actually what I was on the phone with her about when she gave me an urgent message meant for you!**

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltitjk-duchtdja-t/) As I mentioned earlier, two very generous _Students for Life Action_ donors _– one from Texas and one from Florida –_ just agreed to a whopping **[$200,000 Matching Challenge](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltitjk-duchtdja-i/)** in support of our 2024 election year Battleplan!

And when I told Heather about it during our conversation, her voice lit up with excitement!

She told me to tell you how incredibly helpful reaching this **[$200,000 Matching Challenge](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltitjk-duchtdja-d/)** would be to _Students for Life Action’s_ election plans – but more specifically, how helpful it would be for HER canvassing efforts in Arizona.

She told me:

_"This matching challenge will be a HUGE blessing. With this we will be able to spread even more of the pro-life message to change hearts and minds. The more we’re able to do in Arizona the more people will commit to vote pro-life first!"_
So Pro-Life Friend, now that you know how much it would mean to Heather and the rest of our canvassers _(as I’m sure she speaks for our dedicated activists across the country)_ . . .

**[Would you please consider making your most generous contribution right away to have your gift DOUBLED during this $200,000 Matching Challenge](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltitjk-duchtdja-h/)?**

I want to be able to help Heather and our other pro-life activists as much as I can as they’re on the front lines fighting to **_WIN_** our critical election battles in 2024.

So, if you have the ability to do so, right now:

**[A $1,000 gift is really worth $2,000](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltitjk-duchtdja-k/)!**

**[A $500 gift is really worth $1,000](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltitjk-duchtdja-u/)!**

**[A $250 gift is really worth $500](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltitjk-duchtdja-o/)!**

**[A $100 gift is really worth $200](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltitjk-duchtdja-b/)!**

**[And even just a $50 gift is really worth $100](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltitjk-duchtdja-n/)!**

Pro-Life Friend, I only hope and pray that, with Heather working long days to secure a future for every preborn baby in America, **[that you can find it in your heart to think of her and the work she does if you decide to give today](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gltitjk-duchtdja-p/).**

Thank you for everything you do for Life.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: **_Be careful what you wish for._** I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. **[That said, I must ask: will you rush a contribution to my senate campaign today?](http://links.gopstateallies.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=bd19cd5fb0fd4f16b8de2443ce3fb871&_e=aBFMLANbnCycjyBvyCC5Vxu18wznjliM_1N-O6t7NFTvwV_niItJYU12DCE9jOHHUTKZIat5pFZA1CrVJp8AJvyv5gLeMjjyUFaoNl3ijOQuLMqjvrQ4TGtGONwqkFiordRC8xw-ACI2LdO2Yv0v3QS0NH_jBJyV8QqWgGuIo8FN0eEPlkvfHEbqUP7b2QuaxSZkTj2edBg54_NWtZed2FjE034j70w9qiuqD-pkZtTr8EDliggP33OyQyHVcSszf6D6CWxr1iC8eIpuiC4V1FUdnBokFSmhT0SpF-pQ3ZXTKFyEMoUgGfGa86e9YfdC9QAq-ACeetJBqL5hY3qKmdtDnIiWxa9qu2XYxbDHtP56jbeYmE-256XQeN1O2V2RQUvZI1Zr0CUfCOrSHw-kZw%3D%3D) ** This is going to be an expensive fight. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you!

Fellow American,

You may already know who I am from my time in Congress serving North Carolina’s 8th District. Or you may be coming across me for the first time. Either way, I’m glad to be reaching out to you, and I think this could be the beginning of a great relationship. My name is Dan Bishop, and I’m running for Attorney General for North Carolina with the intention of bringing Law and Order back to the Tar Heel State.

**[This email is a bit longer and I hope you’ll read through it. I’m going to ask you for a donation to my campaign at the end of this email, but let me explain why it’s so crucial you join my team first.](http://links.constitutionpress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=5b1b7f6745a442b5b8bb19b19eaacca3&_e=hFNiXxW1PB73aiqyEd3Su_JXCW75VNnZylvnEvK47ekOH0IH8YdAzpEcvL4ZpGAIOsRB4ZRiB6zzX5S3wiNjUy8uIn6nrU4HHtEiZABXvH_JlJ89DZMv6ZQ9w8J9_netxCBNPTYd6QluCmwc-Jo-U2GFnfNSgRcwnQqx08EwS6_XZ5hOxswOasMIqNIcCXxVwE1aVjNd2PJvHa8OaZrBos5HVAAS589mP2zdcelQDtEApC2VGtP4HXCtI1XxGKKLvZ0KkMl9Is60z44U2TmuViyoBL3kwoF7aIyVktK-xBK2whLMbkq4C6DCXJdRWHOcIc9-MfNA_7gUFSEftnFn7fgHd4BH6AzTqRBmI6OmFCiV6BmmbYDMPBJoYMQpv7mEhtG3sNPPGEP9-2V-cCjMXA%3D%3D)**

[](http://links.constitutionpress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=5b1b7f6745a442b5b8bb19b19eaacca3&_e=hFNiXxW1PB73aiqyEd3Su_JXCW75VNnZylvnEvK47ekOH0IH8YdAzpEcvL4ZpGAIOsRB4ZRiB6zzX5S3wiNjUy8uIn6nrU4HHtEiZABXvH_JlJ89DZMv6ZQ9w8J9_netxCBNPTYd6QluCmwc-Jo-U2GFnfNSgRcwnQqx08EwS6_XZ5hOxswOasMIqNIcCXxVwE1aVjNd2PJvHa8OaZrBos5HVAAS589mP2zdcelQDtEApC2VGtP4HXCtI1XxGKKL5QE_CLUDGAtYAjb1cP-1lRPqn1Vrdj-FPOUtSZLlZUtfSGENnD7Ej8uSBH81Uvas5Gvf92xG8n0lW_V9F2GiFEM5y_4a2MPOxrxKiIdLbGS7SdLJDNVBeOI8zwkU4ft38B0jlVhkz-sp9_LB6n8FYg%3D%3D)
I was born and raised with my four siblings in North Carolina by my parents, Kaytee and Bud. They didn’t come from much, but they pushed me towards an education and instilled a hard work ethic. With a passion for law and justice, I earned my JD at UNC Chappel Hill. I then went on to marry my wife of 25 years (and going), Jo; we raised our son, Jack, who’s currently following in his dad’s footsteps as he’s working to attain his law degree.

As a lawyer, I’m very proud of my track record. I was a commercial litigator for nearly three decades, where I was voted 10 times to Business NC’s “Legal Elite” and was selected 7 times by “Super Lawyers.” I was tenacious as a litigator and handled complex cases. But, I finally felt that it was time to help a broader scope of North Carolinians and decided to run for Congress.

In Congress, I’ve been one of the toughest and most outspoken conservatives, challenging the radical left and holding my fellow Republicans accountable. As a member of the judiciary committee and the subcommittee on the weaponization of the federal government, I fought the Biden administration’s dangerous policies and exposed the federal government’s abuses against the Trump presidency.

Now, I’m running for Attorney General to defend the rule of law and protect North Carolina. I believe Democrats like Roy Cooper and Josh Stein have abused the state’s top law enforcement office by turning it into a stepping stone for higher office and a platform to spread liberal propaganda. I’m putting my foot down, demanding respect for the office of Attorney General, and bringing Law and Order back to our great state.

**All that to say, I have a track record of fighting the good fight. And I hope you’ll join my team. The good fight is not free; running a campaign gets expensive, having to reach voters across the state, taking care of campaign staffers with food and gas, and running ads on TV.** **[That’s why I’m humbly asking you for a donation of whatever you can afford.](http://links.constitutionpress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=5b1b7f6745a442b5b8bb19b19eaacca3&_e=hFNiXxW1PB73aiqyEd3Su_JXCW75VNnZylvnEvK47ekOH0IH8YdAzpEcvL4ZpGAIOsRB4ZRiB6zzX5S3wiNjUy8uIn6nrU4HHtEiZABXvH_JlJ89DZMv6ZQ9w8J9_netxCBNPTYd6QluCmwc-Jo-U2GFnfNSgRcwnQqx08EwS6_XZ5hOxswOasMIqNIcCXxVwE1aVjNd2PJvHa8OaZrBos5HVAAS589mP2zdcelQDtEApC2VGtP4HXCtI1XxGKKLxSEBCBedejgoRKBITgDGyH9LYS-04vZfFPnAVGuNYs3TmYPl6xl68dAf7P9m5oOQZPIz9HCs6Qj2-jpQjMQLdhpQf965VeYVrx6Op2IwACatf7Wgi-P_DgohZBnJwkttALEyMC6N9nhOFOCtiZPbSg%3D%3D)**

If you’ve gotten this far, I want to personally thank you for reading this email. Maybe it means you’ve been a supporter for quite some time. Or maybe it means you’re intrigued by my story and also believe in Law and Order over Chaos and Disorder. **[Either way, can you send my campaign just $1 or more to help me out?](http://links.constitutionpress.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=5b1b7f6745a442b5b8bb19b19eaacca3&_e=hFNiXxW1PB73aiqyEd3Su_JXCW75VNnZylvnEvK47ekOH0IH8YdAzpEcvL4ZpGAIOsRB4ZRiB6zzX5S3wiNjUy8uIn6nrU4HHtEiZABXvH_JlJ89DZMv6ZQ9w8J9_netxCBNPTYd6QluCmwc-Jo-U2GFnfNSgRcwnQqx08EwS6_XZ5hOxswOasMIqNIcCXxVwE1aVjNd2PJvHa8OaZrBos5HVAAS589mP2zdcelQDtEApC2VGtP4HXCtI1XxGKKLMAhWTXR8Ien5FPkhN52hc4uZ3ZOCZtn0UpD0JzrJmhI7HDfilwvwJiNp-rZL_rh9j0jqo_P1JYw0MhOTI3BJhuDUHHhuDHmwFWGnJeGHzOpK4nI_vULKYsoQMQzxtDsfIwSRVUwCEw2IStR70fVZjg%3D%3D)**

Thank you,

clean_body: In case you don’t know this about me already | Fellow American, You may already know who I am from my time in Congress serving North Carolina’s 8th District. Or you may be coming across me for the first time. Either way, I’m glad to be reaching out to you, and I think this could be the beginning of a great relationship. My name is Dan Bishop, and I’m running for Attorney General for North Carolina with the intention of bringing Law and Order back to the Tar Heel State. I was born and raised with my four siblings in North Carolina by my parents, Kaytee and Bud. They didn’t come from much, but they pushed me towards an education and instilled a hard work ethic. With a passion for law and justice, I earned my JD at UNC Chappel Hill. I then went on to marry my wife of 25 years (and going), Jo; we raised our son, Jack, who’s currently following in his dad’s footsteps as he’s working to attain his law degree. As a lawyer, I’m very proud of my track record. I was a commercial litigator for nearly three decades, where I was voted 10 times to Business NC’s “Legal Elite” and was selected 7 times by “Super Lawyers.” I was tenacious as a litigator and handled complex cases. But, I finally felt that it was time to help a broader scope of North Carolinians and decided to run for Congress. In Congress, I’ve been one of the toughest and most outspoken conservatives, challenging the radical left and holding my fellow Republicans accountable. As a member of the judiciary committee and the subcommittee on the weaponization of the federal government, I fought the Biden administration’s dangerous policies and exposed the federal government’s abuses against the Trump presidency. Now, I’m running for Attorney General to defend the rule of law and protect North Carolina. I believe Democrats like Roy Cooper and Josh Stein have abused the state’s top law enforcement office by turning it into a stepping stone for higher office and a platform to spread liberal propaganda. I’m putting my foot down, demanding respect for the office of Attorney General, and bringing Law and Order back to our great state. All that to say, I have a track record of fighting the good fight. And I hope you’ll join my team. The good fight is not free; running a campaign gets expensive, having to reach voters across the state, taking care of campaign staffers with food and gas, and running ads on TV. If you’ve gotten this far, I want to personally thank you for reading this email. Maybe it means you’ve been a supporter for quite some time. Or maybe it means you’re intrigued by my story and also believe in Law and Order over Chaos and Disorder. Thank you, Dan Bishop | Paid for by Bishop for NC PO Box 1285 Waxhaw, NC 28173

Hi friend,
After a weeks-long recount process following an unprecedented tie in our primary election, it’s been officially reaffirmed – I am advancing to the general election!
We did this together and it would not have been possible without each voter and supporter who has proudly stood with our campaign. More than anything, this election reminds us that every single vote and form of participation matters – especially in an election year as consequential as this one.

Greetings!
The Left has reached a new low.
Recently, you may have heard that Joe Biden announced a radical overhaul of Title IX rules.
What you may not have heard is how this radical change pushes the transgender industry on millions of kids.
Here is the impact that Joe Biden's actions could have on your kids and grandkids:

* Protections for girls in private spaces like locker rooms are erased -- opening the door for biological males to undress with high school girls.

* State laws that protect girls' sports from biological men are now subject to challenge by the federal government.

* Federal employees, including teachers, are now open to sexual misconduct penalties for using accurate pronouns.

* Collegiate sororities are now under legal pressure to accept biological males to room in their homes on campus.

Please note -- this is Joe Biden and his unelected, federal bureaucracy forcing gender ideology on our kids in local schools.
These rule changes did not receive a vote. There was no debate. This is a federal, top-down abuse of power to pit our government against parents.
The only way to end these attacks is to let families know about Joe Biden's attacks on our rights and to get them to the polls.
[Please consider giving today to help us launch our new ad featuring Riley Gaines to reach 5 million families in the most important, battleground states. You can view the ad below:](https://bcu8ldbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001kscm5_woqJ9mO1fsclfqlQE2WqssICIVK2WAh_idZdUX-tUALtTUaPLf18wx-JTWj5MpfREkRuknctqCpHKCRywfdd4qoK7Y1EnVcz13nSq9Amcu8iFVn3Y5WX99sPiUky7hVAPOAMMY2WiIikm0r4Pd0mRDK6Y7_yUmSZtvTvjlUBnX9GebQPGJ4RsnE-OfaQX-qL_ah5CVVMwN5T-malZZOlIfue2X&c=c7Mw1it9QusvSyXeFmHe9A3xQJJbK7h2P7YZxCgWF16RoWfBo6SWjQ==&ch=iNU8W5cnuOnoV8ELK2ZCRXW8SlE1rRPFpxq_lAo0NL-t0Ro68SbmgA==)

## Do you think that most Americans understand how the Electoral College works and its role in preserving free and representative government?
[YES](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2n313lv9aedsg36kur66c5jo6njp8od0lk8sfu8_rp22sh2s8i6ep31cdgm2o30sjh2bs) [NO](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z5p3htpo6cg6htblo3b6d5ggprgtkqf17do3k198_rp22sh2s8i6ep31cdgm2o30sjh2bs) Dear Fellow American, I am enclosing a survey on a very urgent matter. It will only take a moment of your time, but the topic is vital to our nation's future. A movement is growing, led by progressives--but supported by many well-meaning Americans--to change the way we elect our president. In effect, it seeks to do away with the Electoral College as devised by the Framers of our Constitution. That's why Hillsdale College is conducting a **National Survey on Presidential Selection.** By completing this survey and returning it to me as soon as possible, you will help Hillsdale College more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans concerning this issue--views we will make available to policymakers and opinion leaders. You can complete the **National Survey on Presidential Selection **by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/electoral-college-survey](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkq38ogtev0rmhhh7m715rd461l2dvk0a4qsslhg_rp22sh2s8i6ep31cdgm2o30sjh2bs)** Please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Presidential Selection today**. body:
In this six-lecture course, you'll explore some of the major themes of Genesis

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/3lzEK_GEXNGzl7U6PllLKA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoFez-P0StaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2dlbmVzaXMtZHZkLW9mZmVyP3NjPTAwNDcxTjAyNDJMMTVET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1nZW5lc2lzX2R2ZCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1QQS1ST04tMjAyNDA1MDJXA3NwY0IKZickUzNm0mZctFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~) Dear Fellow American,

I hope you're having a good day. I'm writing with some exciting news.

Hillsdale College's popular online course, **" The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives,"** is available on DVD.

[](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/3lzEK_GEXNGzl7U6PllLKA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoFez-P0StaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2dlbmVzaXMtZHZkLW9mZmVyP3NjPTAwNDcxTjAyNDJMMTVET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1nZW5lc2lzX2R2ZCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1QQS1ST04tMjAyNDA1MDJXA3NwY0IKZickUzNm0mZctFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)In this six-lecture course, you'll explore some of the major themes of Genesis, including the complex relationship between God and man, and what it reveals about divine and human nature.

"The Genesis Story" is taught by Hillsdale College professor of English Justin Jackson, who has taught the subject to undergraduate students here at the College for 15 years. This course aims to deepen a student's theological understanding of the Old Testament by revealing the literary beauty and complexity of the text.

The course begins with a lecture and introduction by the President of Hillsdale College, Dr. Larry P. Arnn, in which he explains why we teach the Book of Genesis at Hillsdale College and why it's important to both faith and higher education.
Then, Dr. Jackson explains the four relationships that dominate the Book of Genesis: God and creation, God and man, man and man, and man and creation.

These relationships are explored in the narratives of Adam and Eve, Abraham and Sarah, Abraham and Isaac, Jacob and Esau, and finally, Joseph.

This course on DVD is perfect for viewing in your home with your family or for use in small groups such as Bible studies and book clubs.

**For your tax-deductible gift of $100 or more in support of Hillsdale College, you 'll receive the DVD as our thank you.**

To receive your Genesis DVD box set or to give it as a gift, please use the secure link here: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/support-genesis](http://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/3lzEK_GEXNGzl7U6PllLKA~~/AARclAA~/RgRoFez-P0StaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmVkLmhpbGxzZGFsZS5lZHUvaGlsbHNkYWxlL2dlbmVzaXMtZHZkLW9mZmVyP3NjPTAwNDcxTjAyNDJMMTVET0RFRVMmdXRtX3NvdXJjZT1wcm9zcGVjdGluZyZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1nZW5lc2lzX2R2ZCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1QQS1ST04tMjAyNDA1MDJXA3NwY0IKZickUzNm0mZctFIUZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb21YBAAAAAA~)**

As you know, Hillsdale College refuses EVERY PENNY of state and federal government funding--even indirectly through student loans and grants. That's why your support is so crucial.

Your gift helps expand Hillsdale College's national educational outreach efforts to educate millions of Americans nationwide, including our nation's youth. Your gift will also help to:
* Increase the number of students taking free online courses, such as "Genesis."
* Expand the readership of _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty.
* Establish and guide classical K-12 schools nationwide and provide, free of charge, Hillsdale's American classical K-12 curriculum to thousands of American educators and homeschoolers.
* Promote the principles of American constitutionalism through social media and the radio.

Friend, please use the secure link above to make a $100 contribution in support of Hillsdale's educational outreach, and explore the beauty of the first book of the Bible with your new DVD set of **" The Genesis Story: Reading Biblical Narratives."**

Warm regards,

Bill Gray
Class of 2001
Vice President
National Donor Outreach
Hillsdale College

**Good Morning**! On this date in 1939, Lou Gehrig's streak of playing 2,130 consecutive baseball games came to an end, a record that stood until 1995. Two months later, Gehrig gave his iconic farewell speech in Yankee Stadium. subject: C.S. Lewis’s Profound Insights
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.libertyledger.)
---
| | Dear Friend,C.S. Lewis was a master at addressing life’s most important questions through vivid language that is delightful and captivating to read.

His signature ability to communicate the truth about Christianity has inspired countless skeptics to become believers and even more believers to renew and deepen their faith—making him the greatest Christian apologist of the twentieth century.

That’s why we produced “[**C.S. Lewis on Christianity,**](http://trk.libertyledger.)” which you can now own on DVD.
---
| [](http://trk.libertyledger.-Oxa5i6baqf5Qg)
---
| | In this course you will learn Lewis’s profound insights on the central topics of Christianity, including:
* good and evil,
* conversion and faith,
* prayer and the Bible,
* suffering and death,
* heaven and hell, and much more.

Dr. Ward is a Distinguished Visiting Professor at Hillsdale College and a member of the Faculty of Theology and Religion at the University of Oxford. He is the author of _Planet Narnia: The Seven Heavens in the Imagination of C.S. Lewis_ and _After Humanity: A Guide to C.S. Lewis’s The Abolition of Man_, and the co-editor of _The Cambridge Companion to C.S. Lewis_. He even spent three years living in Lewis’s Oxford home as the resident Warden of The Kilns!

This course is especially moving because it examines C.S. Lewis’s beautiful writings about faith and traces Lewis’s own journey from skeptic to believer. The combination provides an opportunity for us to grow in our knowledge and understanding of Christianity.

That’s why I hope you’ll join us in examining the eternal questions of Christianity with C.S. Lewis with [this beautiful DVD box set](http://trk.libertyledger._47UoqlDsA).

Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, ’09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

| | | Peter, I’m running for re-election in Rhode Island for the United States Senate. [I’m hoping you’ll split a $10 donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action](https://default.salsalabs.org/T197cbbb9-3412-488e-9b64-8f6d7f4efdbd/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) – and here’s why. It’s been clear for a long time that the Supreme Court has a corruption problem. I recently published a law review article highlighting how this captured Supreme Court often simply makes up false facts to arrive at decisions that ultimately benefit partisan Republican special interests. Take Citizens United v. FEC as an example. Remember when the Federalist Society justices said that all the unlimited political spending they were unleashing would be “transparent”? Well, we’ve seen dark money in politics prove them wrong several billion times over. Our system is designed to leave fact-finding to the lower courts that hear testimony, make credibility determinations, and review evidence. The Supreme Court is then supposed to defer to – and not alter – factual records in its decisions. Think about it: if the Highest Court in the Land makes up phony facts, there is nowhere else the parties can appeal to. The captured Roberts Court has done a lot of this phony fact-finding in big decisions that have fundamentally changed life in America. The Dobbs decision that ended a fundamental freedom for women is another one that was built on made-up history. How are the American people supposed to trust a Court that makes up its own rules to concoct decisions that suit right-wing special interests? [I won’t give up my fight to improve transparency and accountability at the Supreme Court, but I need your help. Split a contribution today to send me back to the Senate so I can protect American democracy and make sure our Court is giving Americans the fair shake they deserve.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tebd9cfd6-d9bc-45d0-8748-e1cffe1e686f/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

May 2, 2024 Over the past two months Jim Himes has seen fit to issue commentary for the media, both press and TV interviews, on a seemingly endless number of issues that fit the Democrats' agenda. He's spouted off about Speaker Mike Johnson visiting Connecticut, court rulings on abortion pills, fundraising, more money for Ukraine, J-6 fear-mongering, fundraising, border deceptions, federal $ sprinkles for local parks, fundraising, in-vitro fertilization, capped insulin costs, fundraising, solar panels for Bridgeport, and chaos in the House of Representatives - among many others. Notably absent from his daily self-serving jabbering, is any mention of the top domestic issue festering over the past couple months - the outrageous pro-Gaza and antisemitic demonstrations which spread across the campuses of dozens of universities across the country. In the past week they went from threatening and intimidating to literally erupting into full-blown violence on many campuses. Dozens were arrested at UConn, while after a couple weeks of disruptive demonstrations at Yale, the protestors kept their intimidating anarchy moving to avoid arrest. I personally documented the protests at Yale last week in this [article](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001rC68nky0MGj721Y_Xf26WfF7N8An1tOBlOpafHllqBW8v9LomNp5D1R4Vtymhqty5hTeNyErwSTh95y98N2SWLG1be0urJGG95E4m0kQlgn-rqtSLUfWxwpb9_VSSQuKnwMDmd_IjOZg02sSt1ByI3un58-NnOsi0poniTbdbNlNst4NdAwvQHchO6l7BmMtddcWy4a16xWFDoguEYFjaw==&c=R0O0cH6BR8TONwnlXQyfJvMi1I8Wrbrd_ek8wnFxefIjl4_8VPmFEw==&ch=BbXazFHPLaqZCxZ7vqyqIj8YYxvrWoBDqDFJBb2bVcwX5wFZIdxK7Q==) in The Connecticut Centinal. I gave an on-camera interview to FOX 61, but they only aired commentary supportive of the demonstrations. But not a peep from Mr. Himes on this critical national issue - on which moral clarity is an imperative... and should be a no-brainer! He's probably hiding under his DC desk with Dick Blumenthal and Chuck Schumer. Democrat mouthpieces like Himes, who usually seek out face-time on TV, have run for the hills on this issue. They're trying to wish it all away. And there's a plain explanation for their behavior. It is because Democrat operatives, and agents of the organized American Left over the years, have sown the wind with the seeds of national subversion. And they are reaping the whirlwind in such a profoundly obvious and demonstrable way, that they dare not even approach a microphone. Take a good look - it may be the first time Democrats have been caught speechless! From the anti-war demonstrations in the Vietnam era, to Occupy Wall Street, to the Ferguson riots, to the Floyd protests and the BLM burning of the cities, Democrat politicians have not been shy about visibly supporting and using disruptive, violent anarchy for their purposes of accumulating and exercising power. But twentieth century history informs us that the use of such 'cats-paws', once unleashed, eventually cannot be controlled by their would-be masters in the ruling political party. The Democrats have escaped responsibility for these violent subversive uprisings over the past dozen years, but this time there is no escape - and they know it. The reason is that they have quite visibly cultivated, nurtured and funded the most innately violent of the American Left's front groups (remember Pelosi cheering on the Antifa/BLM riots and Kamala Harris raising funds to bail them out). Over the decades these activist groups, e.g. Antifa, have served to activate and advance the Democrat agenda. But their success in amplifying the Democrat agenda, and activating their followers at election time, eventually came to a critical inflection point. These hard-left radical grievance mongers ceased simply doing the bidding of the Democrat party, and instead began making their own demands of elected Democrat officials. For the past decade the demands were made mostly behind closed doors, as we observed Democrat officials push increasingly radical leftist agendas, regulations, and legislation. But after the October 7th Hamas attack, the demands became more public by the radical Islamist lobby, while overt compliance by Biden and the Democrat party became a radioactive endeavor. Biden, in the moment, instinctively came to Israel's side. But his massive hard-left base, now wedded to radical Islamist groups, demanded otherwise. Spokesmen from the Muslim communities in Minnesota and Michigan stated publicly that they would withhold their votes from Biden if he failed to come to the aid of Gaza by holding back Israel in its effort to eradicate Hamas. Yes, the chickens did come to roost in the homes of the Marxist Squad members Omar and Tlaib. Jim Himes, who long ago proved his Marxist [bona fides](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001rC68nky0MGj721Y_Xf26WfF7N8An1tOBlOpafHllqBW8v9LomNp5D1R4Vtymhqty6x6zcppigP4O54RUJ2RgqXQY1pfgTqR4jLcv1hN4s1JeTZfNgUDUHloyYp1g3uNiySNkNky4h_XhugBbu273yg==&c=R0O0cH6BR8TONwnlXQyfJvMi1I8Wrbrd_ek8wnFxefIjl4_8VPmFEw==&ch=BbXazFHPLaqZCxZ7vqyqIj8YYxvrWoBDqDFJBb2bVcwX5wFZIdxK7Q==), has head-faked and duplicitously tried to both sate the radicals in his base, while verbalizing minimal support for Israel throughout the past seven months. I called him out on it all in a [Breaking Commentary](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001rC68nky0MGj721Y_Xf26WfF7N8An1tOBlOpafHllqBW8v9LomNp5D1R4Vtymhqtyoo-dV8jTV7VKV2vtskWRMLky_0NBtkmhgBbnlPxJQ-iDFBS_7iPiusZaavQ2aHlpXXZ26t7eigBaFdb23ziCfg==&c=R0O0cH6BR8TONwnlXQyfJvMi1I8Wrbrd_ek8wnFxefIjl4_8VPmFEw==&ch=BbXazFHPLaqZCxZ7vqyqIj8YYxvrWoBDqDFJBb2bVcwX5wFZIdxK7Q==) in February. Himes actually had CAIR, a well-documented Hamas support group, lead an online discussion for him on the Israel-Palestine conflict. Now, Himes desperately tries to avoid comment, as the Leftist radicals he has quietly used, nurtured, and depended on for his electoral ends over the years, set out to literally IGNITE college campuses across America! ---
Hello Peter,
The Lies Must Stop!
I just experienced a vile, dishonest, personal attack that demonstrates everything wrong with politics today. I expect this from Dina Titus, but it is disappointing that any Republican would use this tactic.
A couple of days ago, a supporter received an unsolicited email from an anonymous source with a link to a slanderous, lie-filled article about me. Instead of debating the issues and letting the voters decide, this opponent paid a political "assassin" to "kill" my campaign.
We cannot allow this to stand.
Anyone who campaigns this way will only add to the rotten swamp in Washington and cannot be trusted. Whoever financed this disgusting political attack should withdraw immediately.
This article had so many outlandish lies that it would be laughable if the stakes for our country weren't so high. Here is a sample of his disgraceful lies:
Lie #1: "Mark Robertson and his wife Lisa filed for Chapter 13 bankruptcy in May 2005" Truth: I've never filed for bankruptcy. My wife's name is Lesly.
Lie #2: "Robertson owed $1,308.07 in child support from a previous marriage" Truth: I've only been married once - to Lesly for more than 41 years (and counting).
Lie #3: "he owed $14,500 in unpaid income taxes to the IRS." Truth: I've never been indebted to the IRS. I've always paid my taxes.
Lie #4: "Robertson previously filed Chapter 7 Bankruptcy in Idaho in September 2000." Truth: I've never lived in Idaho or filed for bankruptcy anywhere. Lesly and I have lived in Nevada with our family since 1992.
Lie #5: "Robertson advocated for a relaxed immigration system." Truth: I want to tighten immigration laws so that we only allow people in who can contribute to our economy. I will fight to strengthen current measures to control our borders - turn off the illegal flow of people coming into our country. This is a matter of national security. A country that does not control who is coming in puts the security of its citizens at risk. I will fight to immediately end chain migration, visa lotteries, and vacation-birth citizenship.
This is just a sample of the lies one of my primary opponents paid someone to spread. We can't allow an unethical politician to benefit from this disgusting, dirty political hit job. The people of Nevada's First Congressional District deserve better than a dishonest coward who spends big money to send anonymous emails to unsuspecting voters.
I do not know the identity of the person who paid for this, but he obviously has a lot of money and is comfortable spreading lies. If he thinks I will back down, he is dead wrong. I served my country for 30 years in the Army, and I'll fight every day for the people of Nevada. Whoever funded this is desperate, knowing he can't beat me in a head-to-head comparison of our experience, community ties, and record of service.
In the past, I've taken exception to one of my opponents making false claims. In calling him out, I had the courage and integrity to put my name on it. You can see that at [www.TruthNevada.com](https://dwhdqsbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0019wkg2iCPEZ3fx2sA714IuOY2YfHXcHV0mh-yhpncFoe0YHPbNRLkGPx8OTDTrZuF1YDyUncNyfsqSQhCOGkwfCNKh6NNd74l3hrgYaUOTw-csRI6HeBVaMgG5bGtP78MwXXCv1QkvPjgvztf8m_48bu7KYPOR7RZ&c=MblYzWBKCLf9tyXH35V2wv6Nwh7sFUJCbhZNWM6Gsg05sjALwdxLZQ==&ch=axim2ub2wUuCfPqTa7Kguw8QE-uHYLvk6VwjEPMMDGXogZhyhq_iZw==)
Help me spread the truth by sharing this email with everyone you know. If you come across scandalous claims about me, feel free to contact me so that I can set the record straight. You can email me at: Mark@RobertsonForCongress.com

*******

Event Details
GOTV Rally with Jamison Carrier and special guest Vivek Ramaswamy
Location
Grace Assembly of God 6822 US 31 South Greenwood, IN 46184
Time
Doors open at 2:30 pm. Event will begin at 3:30 pm.

Vivek Ramaswamy's endorsement of Jamison Carrier:
"When a young person takes a substance and doesn't know it contains fentanyl, that's not an overdose. It's poisoning. body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hi friend,
I'm headed off to the land of the free today... Florida! I'll be sure to bring back some of that unapologetic patriotism to Colorado. This is the Mountain Minute for Thursday, May 2, 2024.
- Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Rep. Boebert's bill delisting gray wolf from endangered list advances out of U.S. House](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ** BY BRIAN PORTER, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert has delivered on one of the first promises she made to her potential new U.S. House district.

In various debates in the 4th District, Boebert has noted the depredation by the gray wolf in Colorado, and had pledged to pursue a bill in Congress which would remove the gray wolf from the endangered species list. There are an estimated 13,000 gray wolves in the United States and another 30,000 in Canada.

She authored House Resolution 764, titled the "Trust the Science Act", to remove protections the gray wolf enjoys while depredating livestock and other animals in Colorado. The act passed the U.S. House by a 209-205 vote Tuesday, oddly earning Democrat Rep. Yadira Caraveo's support among the four Democrat votes received. The bill was also supported by Republican Rep. Doug Lamborn, but opposed by the remaining four Democratic members of the Colorado delegation to the U.S. House. The 4th District has no representation in Congress following the departure of ex-U.S. Rep. Ken Buck, R-Windsor.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Democrats make deal with governor to redirect TABOR refunds to low-income families](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) ** **** [THE COLORADO SUN](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Colorado Democrats, along with Governor Jared Polis, have reached an agreement to implement significant changes to the [state tax code](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.). The deal involves reducing income taxes and redirecting TABOR refunds to low-income families and the middle class.
* The income tax rate for 2024 is set to decrease from 4.4% to 4.25%, with a corresponding [drop in the state sales tax rate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* The tax rate reduction is tied to TABOR surplus levels, with varying percentage point cuts based on the surplus amount, potentially resulting in the [largest income tax cut](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) in Colorado's history.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[COMMENTARY: Colorado's majority Democrats assault free speech](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **** BY JON CALDARA, [COMPLETE COLORADO](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_Among all protections throughout human existence for political minorities, none greater was ever created before the First Amendment._ _
__For the better part of my life, it was classic liberals and the political left who fought for the right of dissent, guaranteeing government shall not abridge speech._ _
__It was the cultural warriors of my childhood through school, media and Hollywood who drilled into us themes like: "innocent until proven guilty"; "the ends don't justify the means"; "I disagree with what you say, but defend your right to say it"; and "dissent is patriotic."_ _
__Why? Because the political majority needs no protection for its self-expression. The political minority does._ **[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Sheena Kadi, a Democratic Party official, resigns from state treasurer's office](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** **** [COLORADO POLITICS](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* Sheena Kadi, the public information officer and communications director for state Treasurer Dave Young, has [resigned](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.).
* Kadi was under a protective order issued on behalf of Rep. Leslie Herod after [accusing Herod of being a "sexual predator"](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) using an anonymous account also used for state treasurer communications.
* Denver County Court Judge Clarissa Gonzales found Kadi's accusations not credible and granted Herod a year-long protective order, requiring Kadi to stay away from Herod and refrain from posting about her on social media.
* Kadi was also a Colorado Democratic Party officer but faced repercussions, including [exclusion from party activities](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), suspension of access to party resources, and a ban from commenting on party business until April 30, 2027. Despite being on administrative leave for about a month, Kadi's removal from her elected party position by the State Central Committee is anticipated.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Republican Rumble'with a twist' offers triple-header of debates on June 1](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The "[Republican Rumble with a Twist](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)" event will occur on June 1 at the Grizzly Rose in Denver, featuring debates in the 8th and 4th Districts.
* Candidates in the [8th District](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) include Gabe Evans and Janak Joshi, with the winner facing Democrat Yadira Caraveo.
* The [4th District Republican primary debate](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.) will include Deborah Flora, Richard Holtorf, Mike Lynch, Jerry Sonnenberg, and Peter Yu. Lauren Boebert declined the invitation.
* The "twist" involves candidates in the [4th District special election](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), featuring Greg Lopez, Trisha Calvarese, Hannah Goodman, and Frank Atwood.
* Moderators include Ernest Luning, Kelly Maher, Jesse Paul, and Chris Rourke, with Mandy Connell as the emcee.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|

Blue Amp Action said I could reach out to you about my critical campaign that has major implications for the future of our state and our democracy. **I want to explain why I, a Gen Z Indian American with a computer science and law background, quit my job in election security to run against State Senator Shawn Still – who was indicted for being a fake elector.** This is a bit of a long email, so if you don’t have time to read all the way to the end, please [**click here to split a grassroots donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8f9e000f-c318-4c25-a511-c5b955d77536/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _Peter, we are living in a time of dangerous political polarization._ Partisan gridlock has undermined the effectiveness of our government institutions here in Georgia, and the citizens of our state are suffering the consequences. **In my career so far, I’ve worked under Republican and Democratic administrations in my role as a federal election security civil servant.** My public service has been built on fighting for the free and fair elections that serve as the backbone of our democracy. As a State Senator, I’ll be ready to work across the aisle to pass common-sense legislation on behalf of all Georgians. The world is changing around us with recent breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and increased reliance on digitalization and automation. Georgia needs elected officials with expertise in the technology of the future. I’ve helped build startups, and my background at the intersection of law and technology makes me uniquely qualified to provide expertise on these issues at the Georgia Capitol. **Meanwhile, my opponent, Republican State Senator Shawn Still, was _actually_ indicted as part of the far-right attempts to overturn the 2020 election results here in Georgia.** He’s shown he’s unfit for public office through his support for undemocratic insurrectionists. We don’t need this type of representation in Georgia, and we don’t need our taxpayer dollars supporting someone like Shawn Still. **In 2022, Shawn Still self-funded his campaign with $300K of his own money. I don’t have that kind of cash to invest in building our campaign, so I’m relying on grassroots donations to get this campaign across the finish line.** Georgia Senate District 48 – and our state as a whole – deserves better. I’m ready to break barriers and bring diverse new leadership to the Georgia State Capitol. _**If elected, I’ll be the first Gen Z State Senator in Georgia – as well as the first Indian American legislator, and the only state legislator with a computer science degree.**_ [**Peter, can you split a donation between my campaign and Blue Amp Action today to help me win this critical race in the Georgia Senate? I’d be so grateful to have your support.**](https://default.salsalabs.org/T4a49c1ea-0e0e-4adb-9da3-b78b6a919bf8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

subject: Greg Abbott Robs Texans of Their Freedom, One Right At A Time / Greg Abbott priva a los tejanos de su libertad, un derecho humano a la vez
body:
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
Greg Abbott Robs Texans of Their Freedom, One Right At A Time
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/UT%20protester%20palestine%20DPS.jpeg]
Nothing screams “freedom and democracy” like sending Texas DPS troopers in riot gear to suppress peaceful protest, right? [https://www.austinchronicle.com/daily/news/2024-04-24/students-tackled-20-arrested-at-peaceful-pro-palestine-protest-at-ut-austin/]
Gov. Greg Abbott, clearly forgetting that the First Amendment exists outside of his X (Twitter) feed, seems to think that squashing peaceful protests is somehow his “patriotic” duty. We think he may have missed the memo about democracy being all about listening to differing opinions, not muzzling them with riot gear and intimidation tactics.
But hey, nothing says “leadership” quite like turning a university campus into a scene straight out of a dystopian novel.
Just know, when it comes to protecting the rights of peaceful protesters, Gov. Abbott would rather throw on riot gear than his thinking cap.
Don't forget to VOTE
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Vote%20fist.png]
We’ve seen the circus that Texas politics has been, but are you fed up with politicians ignoring our needs? Tired of watching as OUR voices are drowned out by special interests and big money?
We saw and appreciated all that showed up for the last election, but the job is far from done. Harris County residents – there’s a TOP-endorsed candidate who will be on your ballot this Saturday, May 4th – Molly Cook [https://www.mollyfortexas.com/] – and it’s on us to show up at the polls to ensure that we get her into office.
Early voting started Monday and ended April 30th. Election Day is May 4th. To find more info on elections happening locally and to see your ballot, you can click here [https://www.vote411.org/texas] .
TOP Harris County Right2Justice MAC Town Hall
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Harris%20County%20Right2Justice%20Teare%20town%20hall.jpg]
TOP is hosting a Right2Justice Town Hall because we need YOUR help to improve the Harris County court-appointed attorney system.
Join us May 4th from 1 - 3pm at TOP’s Harris County office (1610 Dumble St) to hear from Harris County District Attorney candidate Sean Teare and the Manage Assigned Counsel Director Kenneth Harden to learn more on the new court-appointed attorney system and how it will further support our communities by expanding into felony and juvenile courts.
Your support and participation in this town hall will help create a legal system that is fair to us all, no matter our race, income, or background.
For any inquiries or to RSVP, reach out to our Harris R2J organizer, Lucinda at 832-494-8406.
TOP Tips: Get your Enhanced Library Card
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Harris%20County%20library%20card%20sample.jpg]
TOP’s Immigration Justice campaign was instrumental in advocating for and winning Enhanced Library Card programs in San Antonio, Dallas, and Harris County. [https://www.houstonchronicle.com/news/houston-texas/houston/article/Advocates-tout-enhanced-Harris-County-17059992.php] We will continue to push to ensure that enhanced library cards are seen as an acceptable alternate, non-traditional form of identification by local law enforcement, government officials, and agencies.
Español
Greg Abbott priva a los tejanos de su libertad, un derecho humano a la vez
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/UT%20protester%20palestine%20DPS.jpeg]
Nada grita “libertad y democracia” como enviar agentes del DPS de Texas con equipo antidisturbios para reprimir protestas pacíficas, ¿Verdad? [https://www.austinchronicle.com/daily/news/2024-04-24/students-tackled-20-arrested-at-peaceful-pro-palestine-protest-at-ut-austin/]
El gobernador Greg Abbott, olvidando claramente que la Primera Enmienda existe fuera de su cuenta X (Twitter), parece pensar que aplastar las protestas pacíficas es de alguna manera su deber “patriótico”. Creemos que puede haber pasado por alto el memorando acerca de que la democracia consiste en escuchar opiniones diferentes, no amordazarlas con equipo antidisturbios y tácticas de intimidación.
Pero bueno, nada dice más “liderazgo” que convertir un campus universitario en un escenario sacado directamente de una novela distópica.
Sólo hay que saber que, cuando se trata de proteger los derechos de los manifestantes pacíficos, el gobernador Abbott prefiere ponerse equipo antidisturbios que pensar.
No olvides VOTAR
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Vote%20fist.png]
Hemos visto el circo que ha sido la política de Texas, pero ¿estás harto de que los políticos ignoren nuestras necesidades? ¿Estás cansado de ver cómo NUESTRAS voces son ahogadas por intereses especiales y mucho dinero?
Vimos y apreciamos a todos los que salieron a votar en las últimas elecciones, pero el trabajo está lejos de estar terminado. Residentes del condado de Harris: hay una candidata respaldada por TOP que estará en su boleta este sábado : Molly Cook [https://www.mollyfortexas.com/] , ¡y nos corresponde a nosotros presentarnos en las urnas para asegurarnos de que llegue a su cargo!
La votación anticipada comenzó el lunes y finalizará el 30 de abril. El día de las elecciones es el 4 de mayo.
Para encontrar más información sobre las elecciones que se llevan a cabo localmente y ver su boleta, ¡Haz clic aquí! [https://www.vote411.org/texas]
Reunión pública de TOP Right2Justice en el condado de Harris
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Harris%20County%20Right2Justice%20Teare%20town%20hall.jpg]
TOP está organizando una reunión pública de Right2Justice porque necesitamos SU ayuda para mejorar el sistema designado por el Tribunal del Condado de Harris.
Únase a nosotros el 4 de mayo de 1 a 3 p.m. en la oficina de TOP en el condado de Harris (1610 Dumble St) para escuchar al candidato a fiscal de distrito del condado de Harris, Sean Teare , y al director de abogados asignados, Kenneth Harden , para obtener más información sobre el nuevo sistema de abogados designados por el tribunal y cómo apoyará aún más a nuestras comunidades al expandirse a tribunales de delitos graves y juveniles.
Su apoyo y participación en este ayuntamiento ayudarán a crear un sistema legal que sea justo para todos nosotros, sin importar nuestra raza, ingresos o antecedentes.
Para cualquier pregunta o para confirmar su asistencia, comuníquese con nuestra organizadora de Harris R2J, Lucinda, al 832-494-8406.
Consejos de TOP: Obtenga su tarjeta de biblioteca mejorada
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Harris%20County%20library%20card%20sample.jpg]

Continuaremos presionando para garantizar que las autoridades locales, los funcionarios gubernamentales y las agencias consideren las tarjetas de biblioteca mejoradas como una forma de identificacón, no tradicional, aceptable.

clean_body: Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español] Greg Abbott Robs Texans of Their Freedom, One Right At A Time [] Nothing screams “freedom and democracy” like sending Texas DPS troopers in riot gear to suppress peaceful protest, right? [] Gov. Greg Abbott, clearly forgetting that the First Amendment exists outside of his X (Twitter) feed, seems to think that squashing peaceful protests is somehow his “patriotic” duty. We think he may have missed the memo about democracy being all about listening to differing opinions, not muzzling them with riot gear and intimidation tactics. But hey, nothing says “leadership” quite like turning a university campus into a scene straight out of a dystopian novel. Just know, when it comes to protecting the rights of peaceful protesters, Gov. Abbott would rather throw on riot gear than his thinking cap. Don't forget to VOTE [] We’ve seen the circus that Texas politics has been, but are you fed up with politicians ignoring our needs? Tired of watching as OUR voices are drowned out by special interests and big money? We saw and appreciated all that showed up for the last election, but the job is far from done. Harris County residents – there’s a TOP-endorsed candidate who will be on your ballot this Saturday, May 4th – Molly Cook [] – and it’s on us to show up at the polls to ensure that we get her into office. Early voting started Monday and ended April 30th. Election Day is May 4th. To find more info on elections happening locally and to see your ballot, you can click here [] . TOP Harris County Right2Justice MAC Town Hall [] TOP is hosting a Right2Justice Town Hall because we need YOUR help to improve the Harris County court-appointed attorney system. Join us May 4th from 1 - 3pm at TOP’s Harris County office (1610 Dumble St) to hear from Harris County District Attorney candidate Sean Teare and the Manage Assigned Counsel Director Kenneth Harden to learn more on the new court-appointed attorney system and how it will further support our communities by expanding into felony and juvenile courts. Your support and participation in this town hall will help create a legal system that is fair to us all, no matter our race, income, or background. For any inquiries or to RSVP, reach out to our Harris R2J organizer, Lucinda at 832-494-8406. TOP Tips: Get your Enhanced Library Card [] TOP’s Immigration Justice campaign was instrumental in advocating for and winning Enhanced Library Card programs in San Antonio, Dallas, and Harris County. [] We will continue to push to ensure that enhanced library cards are seen as an acceptable alternate, non-traditional form of identification by local law enforcement, government officials, and agencies. Español Greg Abbott priva a los tejanos de su libertad, un derecho humano a la vez [] Nada grita “libertad y democracia” como enviar agentes del DPS de Texas con equipo antidisturbios para reprimir protestas pacíficas, ¿Verdad? [] El gobernador Greg Abbott, olvidando claramente que la Primera Enmienda existe fuera de su cuenta X (Twitter), parece pensar que aplastar las protestas pacíficas es de alguna manera su deber “patriótico”. Creemos que puede haber pasado por alto el memorando acerca de que la democracia consiste en escuchar opiniones diferentes, no amordazarlas con equipo antidisturbios y tácticas de intimidación. Pero bueno, nada dice más “liderazgo” que convertir un campus universitario en un escenario sacado directamente de una novela distópica. Sólo hay que saber que, cuando se trata de proteger los derechos de los manifestantes pacíficos, el gobernador Abbott prefiere ponerse equipo antidisturbios que pensar. No olvides VOTAR [] Hemos visto el circo que ha sido la política de Texas, pero ¿estás harto de que los políticos ignoren nuestras necesidades? ¿Estás cansado de ver cómo NUESTRAS voces son ahogadas por intereses especiales y mucho dinero? Vimos y apreciamos a todos los que salieron a votar en las últimas elecciones, pero el trabajo está lejos de estar terminado. Residentes del condado de Harris: hay una candidata respaldada por TOP que estará en su boleta este sábado : Molly Cook [] , ¡y nos corresponde a nosotros presentarnos en las urnas para asegurarnos de que llegue a su cargo! La votación anticipada comenzó el lunes y finalizará el 30 de abril. El día de las elecciones es el 4 de mayo. Para encontrar más información sobre las elecciones que se llevan a cabo localmente y ver su boleta, ¡Haz clic aquí! [] Reunión pública de TOP Right2Justice en el condado de Harris [] TOP está organizando una reunión pública de Right2Justice porque necesitamos SU ayuda para mejorar el sistema designado por el Tribunal del Condado de Harris. Únase a nosotros el 4 de mayo de 1 a 3 p.m. en la oficina de TOP en el condado de Harris (1610 Dumble St) para escuchar al candidato a fiscal de distrito del condado de Harris, Sean Teare , y al director de abogados asignados, Kenneth Harden , para obtener más información sobre el nuevo sistema de abogados designados por el tribunal y cómo apoyará aún más a nuestras comunidades al expandirse a tribunales de delitos graves y juveniles. Su apoyo y participación en este ayuntamiento ayudarán a crear un sistema legal que sea justo para todos nosotros, sin importar nuestra raza, ingresos o antecedentes. Para cualquier pregunta o para confirmar su asistencia, comuníquese con nuestra organizadora de Harris R2J, Lucinda, al 832-494-8406. Last week, Tennessee Governor Bill Lee signed legislation allowing teachers and other members of school staff to be armed on school grounds.
#

This is bad news, team.
**Last week, Tennessee Governor Bill Lee signed legislation allowing teachers and other members of school staff to be armed on school grounds with concealed handguns.**
Arming teachers is incredibly unpopular, and it’s not about safety—it’s just a gun industry ploy to sell more guns. Just take a look at these statistics:
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-may24.vNbcqy&refcode=em240502-1-30&t=1&akid=8033%2E3935704%2E306Sgw)
[**We must band together and fight back against this dangerous new law in Tennessee and anywhere else it may pop up. Please, make a contribution to GIFFORDS PAC today to show that this community doesn’t stand for arming teachers.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-may24.vNbcqy&refcode=em240502-1-30&t=2&akid=8033%2E3935704%2E306Sgw)
If more guns in our community spaces made us safer, then America would be the safest country in the world. But as we know, that’s not the case. With gun violence being the NUMBER ONE cause of death for children in our nation, this decision from Governor Lee and the Tennessee legislature is irresponsible and dangerous.
That’s why we’re fighting back. Are you with us?

# Early Voting Starts Today! 🗳️
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=a149d0ea4d&e=0a12281e0e)
Maryland 6th Congressional District voters, it’s time to make your voices heard! Early voting for the Republican primary election begins TODAY, May 2nd, and runs through May 9th, from 7 AM to 8 PM. Make sure to secure your vote for Mariela Roca today!
Find your polling location here! ⬇️
[CLICK HERE TO FIND YOUR POLLING LOCATION](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=2ea2a470f7&e=0a12281e0e)
# We need Volunteers!
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=b74bfe239d&e=0a12281e0e)
Hey there, Team Roca supporters! Are you pumped to be part of something big and flip MD-06 for Republicans this November? We’re gearing up for Election Day on May 14th and we need your awesome energy to help out!

Want to join us in spreading the word by putting up yard signs and handing out literature? Sign up below and let’s flip this seat together!
Can’t wait to have you on the team! ⬇️
[CLICK HERE TO VOLUNTEER!](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=1461df94cc&e=0a12281e0e)
# Fundraising
I know that many of you have already helped our campaign out so much, and many of you have not been able to contribute monetarily due the the economically challenging times we are all facing. I truly believe the future of our district and country is at stake, and I KNOW we can win this nomination with your help through this last push. I have skin in the game as I have also contributed some of my personal funds for this effort. And I really hate to ask you for monetary help, but I need your help now more than ever.
Every dollar you contribute will bring us one step closer to ensuring a Republican victory in November for Maryland 6th, one of the most crucial races in the country that can decide our House Majority!
Please click on the link below to make your secure contribution TODAY:
[**https://secure.winred.com/roca-for-congress/donate**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=fd3c08d25f&e=0a12281e0e)
The future of our Republican majority in the House of Representatives hangs in the balance. We cannot afford to lose sight of the importance of securing seats like Maryland's 6th Congressional District if we want to keep a Republican majority in the House of Representatives. 🇺🇸
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=57cce0aca4&e=0a12281e0e)
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=bc671af5f8&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for Congress MD-06U.S. Air Force Veteran
|

# More about Mariela Roca
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=b08b22d2db&e=0a12281e0e)
My name is Mariela Roca. I want to tell you a bit about myself and why I’m running for Congress here in Maryland’s 6th Congressional District.
[**Once you’ve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution to help boost my campaign’s momentum and WIN BACK Maryland’s 6th Congressional District!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=6662f51904&e=0a12281e0e)
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=89b9f26656&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress because I was raised by a single mom in Puerto Rico who always showed me how hard work and determination is what makes us all live the American dream. I learned english when I was 5 years old, and from that young age always felt so proud to be an American.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=c6874ebad4&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for Congress as a military veteran. I began my journey of service to our nation in 2005 when I joined the U.S. Air Force at the age of 20. During my military service I had the honor of serving my county abroad in the Global War on Terror, serving within the Task Force Medical and the Bagram Theater Internment Facility (BTIF) in Bagram, Afghanistan, during Operation Enduring Freedom in 2007. I know what sacrifice looks like - and this is why I love my country so much.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=55d38e023b&e=0a12281e0e)
I’m running for my kids, your kids, and your grandkids. Everything that I do in my life is to make the best possible future for my daughter and my son and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has offered me my entire life.
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=2c7b340a18&e=0a12281e0e)
[**I’M RUNNING FOR CONGRESS BECAUSE WE HAVE A COUNTRY TO SAVE!**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=383fa604ee&e=0a12281e0e)
Even during our most challenging moments, we are fortunate to call America our home. But it's clear that under the Biden administration, we face significant challenges, our prospects are dwindling, we are weak on the world stage, our economy is failing, and American families are being left behind every single day.
[**I’m running for Congress because America can do better with leaders that will always fight for America first. No matter what.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=17471b316a&e=0a12281e0e)
**As a military veteran** , I intimately understand the profound significance of service and the willingness to make the ultimate sacrifice for my country. My time in the military taught me the unwavering commitment to duty, honor, and the defense of freedom. It's a bond that transcends words; a deep-seated connection with the men and women I served alongside, many of whom paid the ultimate price. I've witnessed the selflessness, courage, and dedication that define the character of those who choose to protect their nation.
**As a medical logistician** , my mission was to ensure that our dedicated warfighters had the essential tools and supplies required to save lives on the frontlines. I understood the critical nature of my role in providing our troops with the medical resources and equipment they needed to deliver immediate care in challenging and high-stress situations. I am now prepared to take the knowledge, commitment, and understanding I gained in that role with me to Congress, where I will tirelessly advocate for policies that will support our country, military and American families first. Above anything.
**As a** **mother** , I understand firsthand the deep commitment and love that comes with the responsibility of providing for one's family. In the countless roles we take on as parents - caregiver, protector, educator, and provider - we become intimately acquainted with the challenges and triumphs of family life. We witness the struggles that many families face, whether it's making ends meet, securing access to quality education, or ensuring our children have the healthcare they need. It's in these moments that we are inspired to take action, to advocate for better opportunities, and to fight for a brighter future for our families.
I know how to make our community, district, and America strong and proud because i’ve done it before.
[**And i’ll do it again as your next Congresswoman.**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=9ec56a0dfd&e=0a12281e0e)
As your next Congresswoman for Maryland’s 6th Congressional District I will always fight for policies that will revitalize our economy, support small businesses, stop Washington’s out of control spending, champion school choice & parental rights, and save America’s future.
But, in order to do this, I need your support today so I can spread this message to everyone across our district and country.
[**Will you chip in today to help me win this fight for our nation’s future?**](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=6732056ae3&e=0a12281e0e)
Together we WILL flip Maryland’s 6th Congressional District for Republicans and make America strong and proud again.
Sincerely,
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=539bc09cc0&e=0a12281e0e)
Mariela RocaRepublican Candidate for CongressMaryland’s 6th District
[](https://rocaforcongress.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=51570106eec2b2b74efc93ea8&id=856dcd8072&e=0a12281e0e)

body:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84172116/470698774/-240735101?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDc3MzBiOS04ZjA4LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sFRh19AImzxyvWu_aAW18WJCM0z7SZ4SrRWa6DXWvV8=) I remember that sinking feeling, two years ago today, when the news leaked that the Supreme Court was going to overturn Roe v. Wade. I bet you remember it, too. Frankly, the damage to women and families across our country since then has been horrific. Forty percent of women in America now live under severe abortion restrictions or an outright ban. Just yesterday, a six-week abortion ban went into effect in Florida. In Alabama, the state court even banned IVF — and most of my GOP colleagues in Congress have come out in support of banning it nationally. **Here in Kansas, we overwhelmingly blocked an attempted abortion ban at the ballot box. And making our voice heard at the ballot box is how we’ll stand up for our rights again this November.** If anti-choice extremists are setting the agenda next year, we know what to expect: severe restrictions on abortion at the federal level. Attempts to block access to abortion medication. Calls to prosecute the doctors who perform abortions and the women who seek them out. But if we retake the House, we can do even more than fight back against that extreme agenda — we can get to work reinstating the fundamental rights that the Supreme Court took away. We can pass federal legislation enshrining Roe v. Wade protections into law, so that no matter what state you live in, your medical decisions are yours alone. [_**Whether we retake the House or not is going to come down to just a handful of competitive House districts and KS-03 is at the top of the list. I know it, and my opponents know it, too, which means this is going to be one tough fight. Can I count on you to pitch in today and help us win this fight to reinstate abortion rights?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84172122/470698786/1393599324?refcode=email_050224_Dobbs-leak&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDc3MzBiOS04ZjA4LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sFRh19AImzxyvWu_aAW18WJCM0z7SZ4SrRWa6DXWvV8=) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | | [Donate $5 →](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84172126/470698793/1393599324?refcode=email_050224_Dobbs-leak&amount=5&express_lane=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDIvMS82NTc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJiZDc3MzBiOS04ZjA4LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=sFRh19AImzxyvWu_aAW18WJCM0z7SZ4SrRWa6DXWvV8=)

clean_body: = I remember that sinking feeling, two years ago today, when the news leaked that the Supreme Court was going to overturn Roe v. Wade. I bet you remember it, too. Frankly, the damage to women and families across our country since then has been horrific. Forty percent of women in America now live under severe abortion restrictions or an outright ban. Just yesterday, a six-week abortion ban went into effect in Florida. In Alabama, the state court even banned IVF — and most of my GOP colleagues in Congress have come out in support of banning it nationally. Here in Kansas, we overwhelmingly blocked an attempted abortion ban at the ballot box. And making our voice heard at the ballot box is how we’ll stand up for our rights again this November. If anti-choice extremists are setting the agenda next year, we know what to expect: severe restrictions on abortion at the federal level. Attempts to block access to abortion medication. Calls to prosecute the doctors who perform abortions and the women who seek them out. But if we retake the House, we can do even more than fight back against that extreme agenda — we can get to work reinstating the fundamental rights that the Supreme Court took away. We used to nickname them “Guardians” for their role in safeguarding troops on the ground.

**This may come as a surprise, but there’s more overlap than you’d think between piloting an Apache Helicopter and running a campaign against radical Left Democrats.**
* My conservative values make me a HUGE target. The Democrat Establishment always has its crosshairs on me—ready to strike.

body:
This is a moment of great consequence. Congress had our first official vote where we can weigh in on the direction of the war in Gaza.
# [](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/892?refcode=em20240502-3829-footer&t=1&akid=3829%2E420207%2EzFV729)
Peter — this is a moment of great consequence. **I am proud to be one of the 37 Democrats to vote against supplying more offensive military aid that could result in more killings of civilians in Gaza.**
Most Americans**do not** want our government to write a blank check to further Netanyahu’s war in Gaza. The United States needs to help find a path to peace and safety.
That is what our vote was about. Voting to continue supplying offensive military aid only makes Congress complicit in this tragedy.
My vote against H.R. 8034 was a vote against supplying more offensive weapons that could result in more killings of civilians in Rafah and elsewhere. The dozens of Democrats who voted with me all believe strongly in Israel’s right to self-defense and have joined colleagues previously in affirming our shared commitment. We are committed to a sovereign, safe, and secure future for both Israelis and Palestinians.
**To protect that future, we believe the United States must help achieve a ceasefire that allows hostages to be freed, humanitarian aid to be delivered, and peace talks to begin.**
Netanyahu appears willing to sacrifice the hostages while inflicting extraordinary suffering on the people of Gaza. He is willing to expand this conflict to preserve his power at the expense of Israel’s safety.
When faced with the question of whether to provide offensive aid to further this conflict, I believe there is a moral imperative to find another path.
[**If you stand with me, please consider supporting this campaign with a contribution of any amount.**](https://act.pramilaforcongress.com/go/47393?c0=pj-email-20240502.C6gYeU&refcode=em20240502-3829&t=2&akid=3829%2E420207%2EzFV729)

In solidarity,
Pramila Jayapal

We are committed to a sovereign, safe, and secure future for both Israelis and Palestinians. To protect that future, we believe the United States must help achieve a ceasefire that allows hostages to be freed, humanitarian aid to be delivered, and peace talks to begin. Netanyahu appears willing to sacrifice the hostages while inflicting extraordinary suffering on the people of Gaza. He is willing to expand this conflict to preserve his power at the expense of Israel’s safety. When faced with the question of whether to provide offensive aid to further this conflict, I believe there is a moral imperative to find another path. In solidarity, Pramila Jayapal | | Email us: info@pramilaforcongress.com

**[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/u/click?_t=5b1853ae48754bee8f471363fe4933a9&_m=982468ff17884df9a64d41dfa05d208c&_e=04kLOV2E_UlZyvdlGnNBoo_llCtxl_Ce_OYhB4AroykD8mUsdN1IAiShyk0UeGVT0Oza5dO7_o-EnMgdpwu5s9L8mZHUseDOxOB55-OpM6bblbk2SRWVW6ECY_0Hf3Kt9zXmQqoDdlbD8uD-fwtM0HUWF33kJzrM-1ZSjiK1t5Hj-HbU35prkeDB-zatnpA_950wof3uGQ_Vo7e-k1fA0UblzNojOZtqgAqJtuZaYDFm9EfH-lFWTjScYbDsIPu7Lu0qH0Cg9MUJfHXZziuWRlA1WPOCGSH2vmwSbzuP5hexLZgaffSS0_AzjThPA_6eTSrxkiPGohydZ8nKNa4iyBF4PBbh7fbAN1PVyo4KEu1XOedm7TFFy1nW1v1S_ctD)**
