Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack.

**You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.**

A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.**

These efforts include:

* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It only has eight questions and will take a few minutes of your time.

Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty.

As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans.

**This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

|
---
| Peter, I wanted to share a touching story that recently unfolded, showcasing **the incredible kindness and generosity** that epitomizes the spirit of New Jersey.
Last week, we received a call from Penny, a 71-year-old woman facing a challenging situation with her broken HVAC system. As she tearfully explained her predicament during a discussion about affordability in our state, **something remarkable happened.** Ryan, a service manager at First Choice Plumbing and Heating, listened to Penny's story and immediately offered a solution: a free HVAC system and installation. Friend,

Last week, I joined a roundtable discussion about the war in Gaza with Jewish and Arab American students at the University of Wisconsin-Madison. I spent most of the time listening. The students talked about the conflict, the protests, and their personal experiences since the war began. While the students rarely agreed, they were thoughtful, respectful, and they listened to each other. In the end, they were exchanging phone numbers so they could stay in touch.

WATCH: Jewish, Palestinian, and Arab American Students Discuss the War in Gaza [https://twitter.com/RoKhanna/status/1785802043208200669]

subject: Beth Ann Rosica: *NEW* NHS-Ordered Report Rules Against Puberty Blockers in Children ⚡🔔
body:
This revolutionary new report is already changing policies and practices in Europe. | | | |
---
| | |
---
| _**UK study has local implications for children and transgender treatments**_
---
| [ ](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=d355fb8fd0&e=b7b3eddce2)
---
|
* * *
---
|
#### Findings from a revolutionary new report on gender identity services for children contradict current US and local practices.
---
| Dive into this report by **Beth Ann Rosica **as she breaks down the groundbreaking new U.K. study that is already changing policies and practices in multiple European countries. Among the study's key findings is that puberty blockers and hormones ought not be given to children outside of a clinical trial, as these drugs in children may impact bone density, executive functioning, height, weight, psychological functioning, and metabolic health.

Beth Ann ties these findings back to the local implications – CHOP's Gender and Sexuality Development Clinic, Nemours Children’s Health's Gender Wellness Program, and the [boom in PA Medicaid spending](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=5f049a38fc&e=b7b3eddce2) on the treatment of gender dysphoria over the past eight years.

---
| [Read More](https://broadandliberty.us3.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a45553d37b628a10a8ae35af1&id=9b63320e51&e=b7b3eddce2 "Read More")
---
|
---
|
## About Beth Ann Rosica:
---
| |
---
Beth Ann Rosica holds a Ph.D. in Education and has dedicated her career to advocating on behalf of at-risk children and families. She became politically active during the extended school closures, speaking out about the detrimental effects on children. Beth Ann led the local grassroots movement to open schools and eliminate mandatory masks while assisting school board candidates across the state and country with their campaigns. She has a consulting business and covers education issues for _Broad + Liberty_. Beth Ann resides in West Chester, PA with her husband and two teenage sons.
---
|

This program has helped over 4,200 students achieve higher education!

https://karenforvirginia.com/ [https://karenforvirginia.com/] Karen Jenkins for HB-89
Donate Here [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/karenforvirginia] Karen Jenkins is a life-long resident of the City of Suffolk. Throughout her lifetime she has passionately advocated for others and currently serves on the Suffolk School Board with a proven track record and history of accomplishments. She is running for the House of Delegates for the 89th District to continue delivering results for the people of Virginia.

body:

| [](https://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=eb1074d314434d4594c7a2336c6d7b89&_e=tiFH2uFcAiwwWAmLXuRa7j8UROxHDiXYEbZAObbUV1bTL75FH8TQkYjQyZDHu6rr-ztTeQkFNdJh5UI3xjPgtSSkZ4M4FKOJAkXzH6ZyNFTCdwKT6ROAjrdzzMnoMa5Qfo33v-5hqeG93CDEW9H4RiQfO9fs2mEYN6IlioyIGADQCRfk-9DFvqsJ2Uweu2MW2ufhOWPyUjPw1APKGl5oHB3adfwdxnZZigg0DxR7cVAhWg4QUsZ10Mo72VsTbGvdJlDWuiGcMxZTEmzzZEU9GfKMIFevwwaMMssWokLDo5ECBrZ0PRv17q_EMPHr8lgbd3FLKHMSgjr8ZKrjvCaDqfM9-P7V673hzpob9OcGFu-rqbONqOFMoSbsfdNOVqIjUXhFQWRNoUUEWbm4CJCdJg%3D%3D)
---
Friend,
---
This letter I've written to you comes entirely from the heart...
---
I knew full well the price I could one day pay for defending President Trump from one of the most vile witch hunts in American history.
---
_But the fight for justice is always worth it._
---
Now, I find myself in a battle for my own freedom and justice as Crooked Joe Biden's accomplices seek to destroy me...
---
**Wall Street Journal: "Trump Advisers, Including Giuliani and Meadows, Indicted in Arizona"**
---

[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/49466?refcode=em20240502-5421&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=5421%2E614464%2E7gWFRA)

**IN 2017:** Matt Kacsmaryk was nominated to be a federal judge for the north Texas district court.
His confirmation stalled for years. We learned he even lied to hide just how bizarre his obsession with controlling people’s bodies really is:
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/49466?refcode=em20240502-5421&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=5421%2E614464%2E7gWFRA)
**IN 2018:** While his nomination languished in the Senate, Kacsmaryk made an investment in his future.
He became a campaign donor to Josh Hawley, a fellow member of the Federalist Society — a group of corporate activist lawyers with funders including Chevron, Google, and the Kochs.
**IN 2019:** Now a U.S. Senator, Josh Hawley decided to make Kacsmaryk, his campaign donor, a federal judge. Hawley confirmed Kacsmaryk to the northern Texas district court — despite bipartisan opposition over Kacsmaryk’s Big Brother views on contraceptives and personal freedoms.
**IN 2022:** A lawsuit was filed in the northern Texas district court by activist lawyers seeking to ban an abortion pill that millions have used safely. Abortion medication accounts for over half of all abortions.
**Josh Hawley’s wife led the suit. His donor was the judge.**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/49466?refcode=em20240502-5421&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=5421%2E614464%2E7gWFRA)

**This was the first time a judge has _ever_ unilaterally tried to take a drug off the market against FDA objections.**
Then, in his official capacity as U.S. Senator, Josh Hawley submitted an amicus brief demanding that the Supreme Court end a temporary injunction blocking the ruling (in his wife's lawsuit) by a judge (his campaign donor) to ban America's most commonly-used abortion medication.
**AND NOW: The Supreme Court is considering the case, argued by Hawley’s wife and originally decided by Hawley’s campaign donor judge, to ban mifepristone, the most commonly used abortion pill, in all 50 states.**
And this is hardly the first time that the Hawley family business has made it all the way to the Supreme Court:
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/49466?refcode=em20240502-5421&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=5421%2E614464%2E7gWFRA)

body:
Nothing matters more in 2024 than ensuring a huge victory for the party of democracy and freedom. That effort runs through Arizona.
#

**Nothing matters more in 2024 than ensuring a huge victory for the party of democracy and freedom. That effort runs through my race, and through our Arizona.**
Here's what our work this year entails:
**Traveling across the state** to build support for our campaign, a Constitutional amendment for abortion access, and to help elect Democrats up-and-down the ballot.
**Building the largest-ever organizing effort** to educate and mobilize Arizonans ahead of this election.
**Fundraising to run a robust paid media operation** that will help educate voters and deliver victory for our campaign.
**And building out an operation that wins not just one election, but delivers victory after victory and confronts the challenges of our time: climate change, defending democracy, economic inequality, abortion access and more in "The center of the political universe" as Politico called it.**
**The times have found us, Thomas Paine once said, and I promise you that I will stand strong in the center of the fight for our democracy and freedom in this campaign and when I am sworn in as a Senator.**
[**But I need the support of people everywhere who are with me in this struggle to make sure we can win. subject: Your post-primary updates

body:
View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/6c2d3cfd1442/we-need-your-help-to-do-big-things-in-13665063?e=95417d7e87)
Logo

Hi Friend Unknown,

Did you know that only 1 in 4 of registered voters cast a ballot on Primary Election Day in the Commonwealth? Turnout was as low as 7% in some precincts.

To expand the electorate and strengthen our democracy, we must vote and encourage others to register and vote as well.

You have the opportunity to determine who will be the next President, as well as PA’s Attorney General, Auditor General, Treasurer and a number of other down ballot state and federal House and Senate seats.

Here's your biweekly roundup of organizational updates, news you can use, and upcoming events to keep you in-the-know.

** NPP in the News
------------------------------------------------------------

Misinformation isn't just harmful; it actively disengages potential voters. Countering these myths is key to empowering communities and defending democracy.

NPP CEO Kadida Kenner highlights the challenges we face in safeguarding the integrity of our elections in the latest NBC News feature. Read more about our fight against election misinformation here (https://nbcnews.com/news/latino/misinformation-migrants-illegally-registered-vote-rcna149557) .

** We’re Hiring!
------------------------------------------------------------

The New Pennsylvania Project is currently hiring! Please see our open positions below:
* Director of Strategic Communications (https://www.newpaproject.org/careers/comms/)
* Regional Organizing Director: Chester & Delaware Counties (https://www.newpaproject.org/careers/rod-delco/)
* Regional Organizing Director: Bucks County (https://www.newpaproject.org/careers/rod-bucks/)
* Regional Organizing Director: Philadelphia (https://www.newpaproject.org/careers/rod-philly/)
* Regional Organizing Director: Montgomery County (https://www.newpaproject.org/careers/regional-organizing-director-montgomery-county/)
* Regional Organizing Director: Lancaster & Berks Counties (https://www.newpaproject.org/careers/regional-organizing-director-lancaster-berks-counties/)
* Community Engagement Associates (https://www.newpaproject.org/careers/community-engagement-associate/) in every region including: Berks, Bucks, Chester, Delaware, Lehigh, Monroe, Northampton, Allegheny, Beaver, Lawrence, Erie, Philadelphia, Montgomery, Dauphin, Cumberland, Lancaster and Centre counties
* Part-Time: Education & Engagement Associate in every region including: Berks, Bucks, Chester, Delaware, Lehigh, Monroe, Northampton, Allegheny, Beaver, Lawrence, Erie, Philadelphia, Montgomery, Dauphin, Cumberland, Lancaster and Centre counties (via affiliated organization (https://newpaprojecteducationfund.org/index.php/eea/) New PA Project Education Fund (https://newpaprojecteducationfund.org/index.php/eea/?nvep=&hmac=&emci=2af94d87-5802-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=19395158&nvep=&hmac=) )

Interested in joining Team NPP? Please email your resume to jobs@newpaproject.org (mailto:jobs@newpaproject.org) and provide the position you are applying for in the subject line.

** Upcoming Events
------------------------------------------------------------

** The Stop Trump Summit—Philadelphia
------------------------------------------------------------

The New Republic is hosting one of the most important events of the season: The Stop Trump Summit.

Kadida Kenner, CEO, the New Pennsylvania Project and the New PA Project Education Fund will be speaking at the event alongside J.J. Abbott, Will Bunch, Senator Vincent Hughes, and other leading voices.

When: Sat., May 18 from 2-4 p.m. ET

Location: The Liberty View at the Independence Visitor Center

Register here to join the event virtually (https://www.eventbrite.com/e/the-stop-trump-summitphiladelphia-tickets-880992059967?aff=oddtdtcreator)

** Social of the Week
------------------------------------------------------------
https://www.facebook.com/NewPennsylvaniaProject https://www.instagram.com/newpennsylvania https://twitter.com/NewPennsylvania

** Courts Matter
------------------------------------------------------------

Can this firm invest in only Black women? This case will decide.

The legal firepower on both sides of the Fearless Fund case reflects the disparate views on the nature of discrimination and the role of history in shaping public policy, The Washington Post reports (https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/2024/04/29/fearless-fund-edward-blum/?fbclid=IwZXh0bgNhZW0CMTEAAR1oOPCOLaHqcRjdymna-gOCpm16tDUSk5VAdgcjpYGDF8uuZ0HlC_9DU5k_aem_Ab3ZL960tLgUz3mp4MgOXXvCajHtWBd7VT8ePT83H183r3HTI04eMTW038aCGtntY8k3yUTRYXIwEdNXcPqiRe_B) .

3rd Circuit Will Not Reconsider Decision on Pennsylvania Undated Mail-in Ballots

The 3rd U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals announced today that it will not reconsider its decision that requires counties to reject undated or wrongly dated mail-in ballots in Pennsylvania, leaving in place the harmful ruling for voters, Democracy Docket reports (https://www.democracydocket.com/news-alerts/3rd-circuit-will-not-reconsider-decision-on-pennsylvania-undated-mail-in-ballots/?utm_source=Democracy+Docket+Newsletters&utm_campaign=535f1c34db-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_15_08_46_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2029d74fb4-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D&mc_cid=535f1c34db&mc_eid=fc8ef67400) .

Pennsylvania Butler County Naked Ballot Curing Challenge

Voters in Butler County, Pennsylvania filed a lawsuit yesterday challenging the county's decision to reject their mail-in ballots for lacking an inner secrecy envelope and not giving them a chance to correct the mistake, Democracy Docket reports (https://www.democracydocket.com/cases/pennsylvania-butler-county-naked-ballot-curing-challenge/?utm_source=Democracy+Docket+Newsletters&utm_campaign=535f1c34db-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2024_03_15_08_46_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-2029d74fb4-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D&mc_cid=535f1c34db&mc_eid=fc8ef67400) .

** News You Can Use
------------------------------------------------------------

20 Pa. legislative primary results that set the stage for November and beyond

As Democrats look to flip the state Senate in November, House Democrats fight to expand their “humble majority,” and established Republicans fend off primary challengers from their party’s conservative wing, the Capital-Star (https://penncapital-star.com/campaigns-elections/20-legislative-primary-results-that-set-the-stage-for-november-and-beyond/) has flagged 20 noteworthy races from Tuesday’s primary.

One of Four Pennsylvanians Turn Out For Primary Election

Just one in four registered Republicans and Democrats in Pennsylvania cast a vote in the state’s 2024 presidential primary, according to unofficial data compiled by PoliticsPA (https://www.politicspa.com/one-of-four-pennsylvanians-turn-out-for-primary-election/134364/) .

Amen Brown declares victory for Pa. House Democratic primary election in 10th District

State Rep. Amen Brown declared victory Monday over his Democratic primary challenger Cass Green by an incredibly narrow margin, six days after the primary election, The Philadelphia Inquirer reports (https://www.inquirer.com/politics/election/brown-wins-reelection-2024-green-blackwell-20240429.html) .

** Important 2024 Election Dates
------------------------------------------------------------

General Election: November 5, 2024

Last day to register to vote: October 21, 2024

Last day to request mail-in ballot: October 29, 2024

** Help Us Expand The Electorate
------------------------------------------------------------

We're on a mission to register new voters in the Commonwealth and expand the electorate.

Help us prepare for the upcoming primary and general elections in 2024!
https://bit.ly/NPPDonate2024

The 2024 General Election is just around the corner but there is much work to be done — and we can’t do it alone! New Pennsylvania Project is on a mission to register 60,000 voters from across the Commonwealth, with a focus on reaching those from underserved and underrepresented communities. We can’t do that, however, without your continued support. If you haven’t yet, please consider clicking the button below and investing just a few dollars in these efforts.

Every dollar helps us host more events, reach more people, and ultimately, register more voters ahead of this incredibly high-stakes election!
Invest in our Democracy (https://bit.ly/NPPDonate2024)

Thank you for taking the time to stay informed. We'll be back in two weeks with the latest edition.

In solidarity,

Hon. Rep. Stephen Adamini endorses Bob Lorinser for Congress

Former Michigan House Representative, Hon. Stephen Adamini, has joined a growing list of local leaders supporting my 2024 run for US Congress.
Friends, we cannot promote or accomplish these major endorsement announcements without you. If you're able, please chip in today to echo Steve's support.
MAKE A CONTRIBUTION [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
ENDORSE BOB [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/altext]
Friends, h ere's what Steve had to say about my candidacy:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP12/1/92793/images/Steve%20Adamini2.png]
I am thankful that Steve also acknowledges my diplomatic service overseas as a significant motivator in his decision to endorse in the primary.
Stephen Adamini was a Democratic representative in Michigan's 109th District from 2001 to 2006. In 2007, Gov. Jennifer Granholm appointed him to the Northern Michigan University Board of Trustees. He currently serves as a member of the Marquette County Commission.
I am deeply grateful for the endorsements I have received and fully recognize the trust and confidence they represent.
I extend my thanks to Commissioner Adamini for his support and for his continued service. I also want to express my gratitude for the broad and diverse coalition I have gathered through other individual endorsements.
Beyond national organizational endorsements and recognition, our campaign has attracted the support of community leaders from across the district, including activists, non-profit founders, educators, trustees, commissioners, candidates, mayors, law enforcement, and veterans.
Most importantly, I value the support of everyday hardworking families in the district.
Our continuing momentum will further solidify my position as the best candidate on the ballot in August and November.
To get there, I need you today, whether it's through volunteering, an endorsement of your own, or a generous contribution. Thank you for your consideration. [https://linktr.ee/boblorinser]
Gratefully / Onward,
Bob
Bob Lorinser

He currently serves as a member of the Marquette County Commission. I am deeply grateful for the endorsements I have received and fully recognize the trust and confidence they represent. body:
It's time to end the era of dirty fuels
| | | | [](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2522032/87SdQ4wZ) |
---|---|---
| President Biden's historic decision to pause approvals for proposed LNG export projects is a vital step towards protecting the climate and those most impacted by pollution—but some lawmakers are doing everything they can to thwart it.

**Tell your members of Congress that you support a pause on LNG.** [TAKE ACTION](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2522033/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Hi there,

Last month, President Biden made the historic decision to pause approvals on exports of liquid "natural" gas (LNG). Now, let's keep it that way while the Department of Energy (DOE) reassesses whether massive fossil fuel developments are in the public interest. (Hint: They're not.)

**What we're fighting for :** LNG expansion has come at the expense of people and our climate. LNG export facilities are often sited in Black, Brown, and low-income communities, who have been forced to breathe dangerous cancer-causing pollution and witness ecosystems around them collapse for decades.

**What we're up against :** Backed by Big Oil donations, Republicans in Congress are doing everything they can to pressure President Biden to backtrack on this commonsense pause.

**What you can do :** Tell your member of Congress that you support this pause and you need them to stand by President Biden’s decision right now. |
---
[SPEAK UP NOW](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2522034/87SdQ4wZ)

| **It's time to end the era of fossil fuels.** We can't let the self-serving interests of GOP members, beholden to the oil industry over the American people, dictate what's best for us and our future. [**Let your voice be heard and tell your Representative where you stand.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2522035/87SdQ4wZ)

Onward, |

clean_body: It's time to end the era of dirty fuels | | | | | ---|---|--- | President Biden's historic decision to pause approvals for proposed LNG export projects is a vital step towards protecting the climate and those most impacted by pollution—but some lawmakers are doing everything they can to thwart it. Tell your members of Congress that you support a pause on LNG. | Hi there, Last month, President Biden made the historic decision to pause approvals on exports of liquid "natural" gas (LNG). Now, let's keep it that way while the Department of Energy (DOE) reassesses whether massive fossil fuel developments are in the public interest. (Hint: They're not.) What we're fighting for : LNG expansion has come at the expense of people and our climate. LNG export facilities are often sited in Black, Brown, and low-income communities, who have been forced to breathe dangerous cancer-causing pollution and witness ecosystems around them collapse for decades. What we're up against : Backed by Big Oil donations, Republicans in Congress are doing everything they can to pressure President Biden to backtrack on this commonsense pause. What you can do : Tell your member of Congress that you support this pause and you need them to stand by President Biden’s decision right now. | | It's time to end the era of fossil fuels. We can't let the self-serving interests of GOP members, beholden to the oil industry over the American people, dictate what's best for us and our future. I can win this election, but we can't do it without your help. _And here are three reasons why we must win:_
1. I believe that neither President Biden nor President Trump will navigate us through the looming debt crisis that threatens our country's very foundation.
2. Their strategies fall short in confronting the perpetual foreign conflicts. There’s no sign that either will halt the relentless cycle of these forever wars.
3. Nor do I see them severing the ties of vested interests that have led to the corporate capture of crucial agencies — whether it’s the Military Industrial Complex’s hold on the CIA, Big Pharma’s influence on the NIH, CDC, and FDA, or the USDA’s sway under Big Ag.

If either Biden or Trump are elected, change will only graze the surface; we’re likely to see minor shifts in policy areas like taxation or abortion rights, but not the sweeping reforms we so desperately need.
No, they won’t dismantle our democracy within their term—the resilience of American institutions is formidable—their presidencies are simply not set to veer away from the well-worn path of politics as usual.
But here stands a chance—an opportunity for me to pivot the nature of our governance, to rejuvenate the spirit of our democracy, and to rebuild our nation's standing on a global scale.
| | **"Here stands a chance—an opportunity for me to pivot the nature of our governance."**

This is about instilling a foreign policy not predicated on the show of military might but on the strength of our economy and the power of our values.
The possibility of enacting such pivotal change, of steering our country back to its principled course, is a calling too pivotal to ignore.
That's why the thought of backing down from this contest doesn’t cross my mind.
The prospect of what we can achieve together is immense, demanding unwavering commitment and a relentless pursuit of the vision we share for America.

No, they won’t dismantle our democracy within their term—the resilience of American institutions is formidable—their presidencies are simply not set to veer away from the well-worn path of politics as usual. Dear Fellow Patriot, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I'm asking you to sign this **[**Emergency Pardon Petition**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cd8a1de1d76e4adb84f26ffc90dfc888&_e=ADlWYX5NS0kP1qO0stv24WoCFI-lVk8tX-PyU0DKG6_FBiH7dV-evjH3zW7WWH5Qs9z__9KsDhxm3xKaq66FExiK8xf83QC7Ug0x-MzliMRNMZRztQUn4Sl2Tw5SqUM-79iqzWykra_Wqe_WB-V1dK9AiH03I81sDsOGwtXwwLXN9qrQdpS6bAeeVOK2r74vXdAcPHgUFstF3gMSwIpjD1vZhHZGOo_Abxqm5fo4JCO6U2_Re-3lw_LlNWAb7KSMOqZLDejv3RHDf4C9eETvskf1xU0ZqZ0FKwXiiKkpVNmS2fNrOv74uo8dSsVBNjstUwiIjD6xzsqU3ZirxjIaAFRZQQHaLuwikfiN6Km-T3IeE4MSAECGLZ5xrcrbGt1L)** because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck - and involved the department's helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home - and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver's side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage. When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.) No doubt Eric saved his partner's life that afternoon - and probably his own. **But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench.** Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric's case - exhausting his options through the justice system. _Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won!_ **A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric 's last remaining options for freedom.** **[Now you know why I'm asking you to follow this link to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition right away.](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cd8a1de1d76e4adb84f26ffc90dfc888&_e=ADlWYX5NS0kP1qO0stv24WoCFI-lVk8tX-PyU0DKG6_FBiH7dV-evjH3zW7WWH5Qs9z__9KsDhxm3xKaq66FExiK8xf83QC7Ug0x-MzliMRNMZRztQUn4Sl2Tw5SqUM-79iqzWykra_Wqe_WB-V1dK9AiH03I81sDsOGwtXwwLXN9qrQdpS6bAeeVOK2r74vXdAcPHgUFstF3gMSwIpjD8ZAbPxexYhSaqEZ4Q3WFfnx0OaMH7aqiZSgUQfUQ9pi5Ljb4GHyAUsGwMhgHJBcmntoDiReMZ07WUh27L5v2U_sQM2Slz8pD391SnG_cksRr1-ZjM3VuRnVINb_-d2kM0Klw_EeiofpBvsdWaVa4J0-ugspapimIpsL5JvetC6f)** My name is Stephanie Mohr and I'm proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund - a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom. I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. You see, I used to be a police officer with the Prince George's County Police Department in Maryland. Then one night I was called to a burglary scene. I did everything by the book - including releasing my canine to apprehend the suspect. We arrested the suspect, an illegal immigrant who was convicted and deported. So, imagine my shock when five years later the U.S. Department of Justice announced it was indicting me for violating the suspect's civil rights by allowing my canine to bite and hold his leg so we could arrest him. And after two trials - in which the government flew in two illegal alien criminals to testify against me - I was convicted. I spent ten years in prison. But I was one of the lucky ones - not only did I have LELDF helping me fund and mount my defense - but they also helped me secure a pardon from President Trump restoring my good name. That's why I can't turn my back on a decorated police officer with a wife and three children at home waiting for him. **And I hope you won 't either.** **[**Will you sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Missouri Governor Mike Parson right away?**](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cd8a1de1d76e4adb84f26ffc90dfc888&_e=ADlWYX5NS0kP1qO0stv24WoCFI-lVk8tX-PyU0DKG6_FBiH7dV-evjH3zW7WWH5Qs9z__9KsDhxm3xKaq66FExiK8xf83QC7Ug0x-MzliMRNMZRztQUn4Sl2Tw5SqUM-79iqzWykra_Wqe_WB-V1dK9AiH03I81sDsOGwtXwwLXN9qrQdpS6bAeeVOK2r74vXdAcPHgUFstF3gMSwIpjD_nu1wYJVXm05frtU_nbvXkD0HxCtgMynBvE7Sljkmphj88lLc4JxX5ePhNjbfLK7mlDjAXsuLlYhxLVFNvCDowX2Xqb8TJZZqJP7pEvsJ7e9oB0hfFo5nl14M1uWMDiWRMTlCBvdu5h0_4T2Vj38bfYrXboGrqvK1UG60WZA6vo)** Eric should have been commended for his service and life-saving actions that day, not convicted and sentenced to years in prison! The reality is we can't get back the last several months Eric has been sitting in prison or the nearly four years this nightmare has been hanging over his head. But with your help today, we can bring Eric home to his wife and three children. **[So please, won't you take just 30 seconds of your time right now to sign the Emergency Pardon Petition to Governor Mike Parson?](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=cd8a1de1d76e4adb84f26ffc90dfc888&_e=ADlWYX5NS0kP1qO0stv24WoCFI-lVk8tX-PyU0DKG6_FBiH7dV-evjH3zW7WWH5Qs9z__9KsDhxm3xKaq66FExiK8xf83QC7Ug0x-MzliMRNMZRztQUn4Sl2Tw5SqUM-79iqzWykra_Wqe_WB-V1dK9AiH03I81sDsOGwtXwwLXN9qrQdpS6bAeeVOK2r74vXdAcPHgUFstF3gMSwIpjD-denhGDVUtfnFS4gFX7WKDNfIZzjW7XXsxVWb_cxSlqexYPqa2JcvUz-87S_Edsb9AlCBFl5v5SuZvPajfn5yttkX0rrzsNDv17bE_1nn7cDp9esQbtX6AERloNrM8WamjAfbAbx6qCl2jod_D2ZH1vA60BqZIMSSDBexP71b5C)** After signing the petition, please make a generous donation to LELDF to fund this petition and the legal defenses of eight officers (including Eric) they currently support. clean_body: a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump | | | | Dear Fellow Patriot, As a wrongly accused police officer who was pardoned by President Trump, I'm asking you to sign this because right now a decorated police officer is sitting in prison for doing his job. On December 3, 2019, the Kansas City Police Department observed a red pick-up truck chasing another vehicle through the city streets. Officers unsuccessfully attempted to catch the truck - and involved the department's helicopter to track it. The chopper tracked the car to the backyard of a home - and Detective Eric DeValkenaere and his partner were the first to arrive at the scene. Eric approached the passenger side of the pick-up and his partner approached the driver's side, both shouting commands at the driver to STOP and SHOW HIS HANDS. Eric saw the suspect reach toward his waistband and grab a handgun, pointing it directly at his partner. Fearing the suspect would shoot, Eric discharged his firearm four times into the windshield of the pick-up as it continued driving into the garage. When officers entered the garage, they found the suspect deceased with his arm hanging out of the window and his .45 semi-automatic pistol on the ground. (A weapon they would later learn was stolen.) No doubt Eric saved his partner's life that afternoon - and probably his own. But instead of receiving an award for his heroic actions, Eric DeValkenaere was charged with Involuntary Manslaughter and Armed Criminal Action by a District Attorney desperately trying to hold onto her elected seat on the bench. Worse, the Missouri Supreme Court just declined to take Eric's case - exhausting his options through the justice system. Even though the Missouri Attorney General agreed Eric is innocent, woke anti-cop prosecutors and the defund the police mob somehow still won! A pardon from Missouri Governor Mike Parson is one of Eric 's last remaining options for freedom. My name is Stephanie Mohr and I'm proud to be on the Board of Directors for the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund - a non-profit organization that supports and defends wrongly accused officers like Eric. Over the last few years, LELDF has helped many men and women in blue clear their names and win back their freedom. I am also one of those officers LELDF has helped. You see, I used to be a police officer with the Prince George's County Police Department in Maryland. Then one night I was called to a burglary scene. I did everything by the book - including releasing my canine to apprehend the suspect. We arrested the suspect, an illegal immigrant who was convicted and deported. So, imagine my shock when five years later the U.S. Department of Justice announced it was indicting me for violating the suspect's civil rights by allowing my canine to bite and hold his leg so we could arrest him. And after two trials - in which the government flew in two illegal alien criminals to testify against me - I was convicted. I spent ten years in prison. But I was one of the lucky ones - not only did I have LELDF helping me fund and mount my defense - but they also helped me secure a pardon from President Trump restoring my good name. That's why I can't turn my back on a decorated police officer with a wife and three children at home waiting for him. And I hope you won 't either. Eric should have been commended for his service and life-saving actions that day, not convicted and sentenced to years in prison! The reality is we can't get back the last several months Eric has been sitting in prison or the nearly four years this nightmare has been hanging over his head. But with your help today, we can bring Eric home to his wife and three children. After signing the petition, please make a generous donation to LELDF to fund this petition and the legal defenses of eight officers (including Eric) they currently support. Remember, LELDF is able to support wrongly accused and convicted officers like Eric and me because of the generosity of patriots like you. And with a pardon the final option to secure Eric's freedom and restore his good name, I'm begging you to Thank you in advance for your support. | | Gratefully, Stephanie Mohr Director, Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund P.S. Without your immediate action, Eric DeValkenaere - a decorated Kansas City Police Detective - will spend the next six years behind bars. His three beautiful children won't have their biggest cheerleader at their graduations, maybe even their weddings. And the only way to get him out is to get Missouri Governor Mike Parson to pardon him. I hope you'll also make a generous, tax-deductible donation to LELDF. No matter what, please pray for Eric and his heartbroken family. | | More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. body:
The Dobbs decision was leaked two years ago today.
| [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84194765/470767200/-3547583?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYwMWRiZTg4LWFmMDgtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=M23KhmcYDrbCuJQyJSB0ssVkFHr5Upi3LXrlhOtAaSc=&emci=ce0573fa-9d08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=601dbe88-af08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=8431045)
---

The average smartphone user gets nearly 50 notifications a day. But two years ago, we all got one notification that would change our country forever. The _Dobbs_ decision overturning _Roe v. Wade_ leaked. We were shocked. We were terrified. And we knew that right-wing extremists in gerrymandered state legislatures were about to unleash extreme abortion bans. And that’s exactly what they’ve done. But what did _we_ do? We didn’t give up. We organized with passion. And we’ve transferred that passion to victories at the ballot box and in court cases — for reproductive freedom, and also for fair maps, so we can have a fair chance to elect candidates who support the right to an abortion. **Today, on the two year anniversary of the _Dobbs_ decision, we’re respectfully asking you to recommit to our fight for fair maps so our elected officials reflect the will of the people and defend our freedoms. **[**Can we count on you to make a donation of $30 today?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/84194767/470767202/2035465197?refcode=don_ndrc_trddnrs_email_mayfun_email_20240502-NDRC-Red-Dobbs_&utm_source=email&utm_medium=email&utm_term=don&utm_content=20240502-NDRC-Red-Dobbs_&utm_campaign=mayfun&amount=30&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxMy8xLzg5Mjk0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjYwMWRiZTg4LWFmMDgtZWYxMS05NmYzLTdjMWU1MjFiMDdmOSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=M23KhmcYDrbCuJQyJSB0ssVkFHr5Upi3LXrlhOtAaSc=) Since that painful day two years ago, advocates like you have stepped up in ways we didn’t think were possible. And voters — even in the most deep-red states — have cast ballots overwhelmingly in favor of reproductive freedom. But I really want you to take a moment and reflect on how you felt that day. Y'all – if we haven't said it in a while, we appreciate you more than you know.

The support this campaign has seen is beyond what Harry ever thought would happen, but we knew that people would have an amazing response to an American hero running for Congress.

We've garnered support from grassroots donors in all 50 states, all while keeping our average donation around $25.

That's because Harry made a promise to serve the people, not big businesses. He's not taking a cent from corporate PACs, but that means he's being outspent on TV ads.

We remember that day all too well, and we're seeing its effects constantly. **Anti-choice Republicans continue to strip away fundamental rights from millions, knowing full well the vast majority of Americans are pro-choice.** Just look at the six-week ban that went into effect yesterday in Florida: not only will it decimate abortion access in the state, it will also affect access across the entire South.

Friend, Housing is a human right, but our government’s investments in affordable housing and public housing have long been insufficient. **That's why I’m urging my colleagues in Congress to invest in affordable housing** , including the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development’s (HUD) affordable housing and homelessness program. I’m also leading a congressional letter to include at least $600 million in next year’s federal budget to fund the State Veterans Homes Program, which provides housing and supportive care for thousands of veterans in Michigan and across our country. On the floor of the House of Representatives, I spoke up about my**new legislation to address our country’s affordable housing crisis: the**** _Public Housing for the 21st Century Act_** _._ If passed, this bill will provide public housing authorities, housing finance agencies, and other entities with the information and assistance they need to adopt the latest best practices in developing mixed-income public housing, from extremely low-income to moderate-income households. Mixed-income public housing—including extremely low-income to moderate-income households—promotes the financial stability and proper maintenance of housing developments, fosters community diversity and integration, and allows scarce federal subsidies to be targeted to the most vulnerable households. [**Can you sign on to support my**** _Public Housing for the 21st Century Act_****to address our country’s affordable housing crisis?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm381rcfdHkIQD_K7aziRYYN5ep7jHmomPt2vI628wPSEnCKCgy0fV2U-beFnPC48MxqvdIurZz9TWswuRUFR_N9gF7cTRTqpNmIzm25vjyTnQyQK4KHP6L_Qe-uJX3BP2_yvg8JZpYycISAwyYV4E_7ctMEA6jLgJDvepB5Ir3khPcxmFmJg4aSIjhRwUqWWrDbsxOYx9ZGbFRw-oJu0Nhypz6xuhYv23NYfaFhHs2QAJYpO9acsbr2Tr13QD-zPJrBVacCWlrW3ZzVtk-qk1H3xMPrXSkn4PgKaVwDaR-5Bhx0Pg5I6u7AgcePeuSjByV_ieCOoC-TkAelo8L_vd2O45dKA-nCTSjCaNLXfCNCoBPcED66EqJnSfPRvdgaqDS89vxE7H6n_AFRVFDN0EGnbi3wvmp52TKAFW_sRTRzmHw/460/WyZsGS_HQJGmeT4iMCovjQ/h1/h001.eFv4Nv5yk5Wxeh05IrEW3Y_8sLFr1lQuQlXg77us8W4) | [SIGN ON](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm381rcfdHkIQD_K7aziRYYN5ep7jHmomPt2vI628wPSEnCKCgy0fV2U-beFnPC48MxqvdIurZz9TWswuRUFR_N9g6Bdk3L2KvCfMtlLfeF4tKRjyEFVHvLxM2heiabLSKeUuGDFw9aFwy8ZvZLouhelNrfFO-P6l-9vvuGc0KdoK1OGGb6TTpv1tYqwV4jszO5WsyHe9arb8hZEdQwwcLURjg09bjMrACQGL6jv9fXcZBnG_RHrsOt8vL1w9Nex_Jau-eoaEM5uUvyUPpYCuMuFpFRFX82bWoztO8SdFPKlEbGPpX4Uf8D0w7NsUOwg0NrEt-7dxEbu7uFR8L6zDQdSByjAM0_7vylbI_83OP9VK9Ida3USx9cMKDLPmb06DtVIX3WigNA86TF4zJNZz-Xq8WTy2XC_Dreb0kriY9hsYOg/460/WyZsGS_HQJGmeT4iMCovjQ/h2/h001.0KfwrZ6VYqI3T6N-oKSio5JYlevpYDiKxqqAySuZQsg)

I’m proud to have worked with housing justice advocates for years, including creating a local legislative working group on housing access and bringing Congresspeople from the House Financial Services Committee to my district to hear from local experts.
When it comes to federally funded public housing, I’ve introduced bills to strengthen HUD tenant protections and to protect public housing residents from dangerous facial recognition technology.
Recently, I introduced legislation to address youth homelessness, which was crafted with young people with lived experience to meet the real needs of our unhoused neighbors.
I’ve also passed legislation to expand homeownership opportunities by pushing for more support for small-dollar mortgages, and to provide financing assistance to low-income households.
**I will continue pushing for housing justice for all, alongside grassroots movements. Together, we can guarantee the human right to housing.**
In solidarity,
Rashida

From: **Rashida Tlaib******
Date: Sat, Apr 28, 2024
Subject: Sign on to support my Public Housing for the 21st Century Act:
To: dpwillis67@gmail.com
Friend,
April is National Fair Housing Month, and we’re in an urgent housing crisis.
With 78% of Americans living paycheck to paycheck and rent continuing to skyrocket, families across the country are facing homelessness. The average renter now pays over 30% of their income on rent.
Public housing is a crucial lifeline, particularly for our most vulnerable neighbors. However, our government’s investments in public housing have long been insufficient.
**To increase affordable housing within the constraints of inadequate federal subsidies, I introduced the**** _Public Housing for the 21st Century Act_** _,_ which will ensure that public housing developers have access to the latest best practices, using local policy tools and financing.

They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they’d rather face me: **_Be careful what you wish for._** I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. **[That said, I must ask: will you rush a contribution to my senate campaign today?](http://links.americanlibertyalert.com/u/click?_t=3c9a9e018cb54768aae32f693c7987c9&_m=c448df99610f410b89054df5a01fb7c6&_e=dD0VYesSsC3-hxAqOhN7kzca7NJjqAqmWDAl_8_Md9T7Sf-aw1h7UGn9IlR59jSqi_wsJ_LJViSVjdh_oYuneuZXz38jxCala8kI3UfQsN2NmatYYBst3KVuCanprMT6Pmr3vCnpubQuPig1noW5E0AeJcwjt5p7f4AH9Gx-tV06IX3GZ7mJbCK9Dt5mupvbsF9Kwm8iGvbK3KMWZDIj6z-hDiP5fhi2GTHjr44tc5Xka6cCBEzG9bntEQQKYm4FHEYlIO2hkuEey5-4AE0-jAbn0sgvpgswxx3UWL3F6e0UrthK66S4Oz0-8I_cvaoU--vWGAhgcnhwxwkKyNx4eG3e8FarGzQOIcFTNFQrn9Ix_vrv7JXGJX44Xc6dCxMYnJGnyrQr6nHMr-iHlOEHr7PypllHi56B8cZ0zLzlCkFYFBiXuwMfYh9qbRiiAAPP2T0OBVdRKJx-1hFkteJiyLzwC0Msr50jgGe1bu1R1lELev3BDGwu9rTD3zm6YMXI) ** This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There’s no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you!

subject: with a heavy heart
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Friend, it's with a heavy heart I’m reaching out to tell you that as of yesterday — May 1, 2024 — reproductive rights are effectively gone in Florida.

**When the Florida Supreme Court upheld Ron DeSantis' already-unconstitutional 15-week ban last month, they gave the green light for his even worse six-week trigger ban to take effect.**

Even when 1 in 3 people only find out they're pregnant after six weeks have already passed.

Even when there are almost no exceptions for rape and incest.

Even when 75% of Florida voters oppose such extreme measures.

We haven't even gone a full day under this law, but one day is too many. And I know I'm not the only one who thinks so: abortion is a winning issue, and we've seen it in every election, red state or blue, since Roe v. Wade was overturned.

So this is not the end of our fight for abortion rights. **It's just the beginning.

We can save our pro-choice Senate majority and codify reproductive freedom nationwide, but it starts with kicking out extremists standing in the way, like Sen. Rick Scott.** [I'm fighting every day to defeat him, but I need your help to reach my emergency $100,000 goal and win. Will you split $10 between my campaign and the Voter Protection Project before midnight tonight to help me flip Florida blue?](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/66534?t=6&akid=14014%2E878179%2EywYUCZ) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Debbie Mucarsel-Powell and VPP will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $10 »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/66535?t=7&akid=14014%2E878179%2EywYUCZ)

Look, friend: This ban has ripped away my rights, the rights of my two daughters, and the rights of millions of women who will be put in danger across our state.

And just so we're clear: **It's all because of the Supreme Court that Donald Trump built, and the Senators who allowed him to appoint the anti-abortion extremists who went on to reverse the protections of Roe.**

Senators like Rick Scott, who proudly says that, were he still governor of Florida, he would've signed that extreme six-week ban.

He's been living in a bubble of far-right extremists. He refuses to accept that the tides are turning in Florida, or that everyday families simply do not support his toxic, anti-choice agenda. _That's_ why I'm running to retire him.

name: Russ Vought
subject: Our plans to make sure an America First agenda is ready on day 1
body:
To accomplish his America First agenda, President Trump needs the authority necessary to hold the legion of federal career bureaucrats accountable. | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us1.campaign-archive.com/?e=17913c7d6d&u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=33c70c91ca)
---
| | |
---
| | |
#
Friends,

Over the past year I’ve been working with policy groups, members of Congress, and conservatives at the highest levels to make sure **President Trump’s America First policy agenda is ready on day one, if he takes office**.

Major media outlets like the WSJ, NYT, WaPo and now [Time Magazine](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=75adfe18f2&e=17913c7d6d) have all written fear-mongering exposés detailing our supposed secret plans for an “imperial presidency” that would “reshape America.” _But I’ve never shied away_ from the policies needed to implement our America First vision for the country.

As I told Time Magazine, recalling my experience in the previous Trump Administration, “the President never had a policy process that was designed to give him what he actually wanted and campaigned on,” says Vought. “[We are] sorting through the legal authorities, the mechanics, and providing the momentum for a future Administration.”

Translation: _We want to be prepared to hit the ground running. The future of our country is at stake. _

**Time Magazine’s****“[Inside Trump’s World](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=dcadaa0f8e&e=17913c7d6d)” chart from their piece.**
---
| [ ](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=012660acc7&e=17913c7d6d)
---
| And yes, we’re prepared to implement paradigm-shifting policies to break the Washington Cartel.

As the piece went on to [report](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=561c4a157c&e=17913c7d6d), ”another inside move is the enforcement of Schedule F, which allows the President to fire nonpolitical government officials and which Trump says he would embrace.”

_My response was clear_. To accomplish his America First agenda, President Trump needs the authority necessary to hold the legion of federal career bureaucrats (you know them as the deep state) accountable. “The mere mention of Schedule F,” says Vought, “ensures that the bureaucracy moves in your direction.”

Friends, I founded Citizens for Renewing America _after serving in President Trump’s cabinet and seeing first hand_ how the federal bureaucracy was not only resistant to our agenda, but had become woke and weaponized against the American people.

And while we can’t predict what will happen in November, that’s not the business we’re in. We’re laying the policy groundwork for an Administration that will put America First.

That’s why I will proudly tell any reporter, activist, or federal bureaucrat the same thing:

**Our goal is nothing short of an America First policy agenda ready to be rolled out on day one of a future Trump Administration.**

**[Your support goes a long way to ensuring this happens](https://americanrestorationcenter.us1.list-manage.com/track/click?u=10a708d6740341bfdc2a52a46&id=a9e52faad0&e=17913c7d6d).**
---
| Sincerely,

Russ Vought
President, Citizens for Renewing America

body:
Derek, thank you.

**April was an important month for our campaign. I’m grateful that more than 80,000 Democrats across Western PA voted in last month’s primary election, and I’m even more honored that you put your trust in me as your Democratic nominee again this year.**

I am proud to represent us in Congress, and I will never take that for granted.

We’re in for a tough fight this year. Now that we are past the primary, we’ve officially landed a right-wing opponent – one who is anti-abortion, anti-worker, and anti-democracy. That makes winning this election all the more important.

And thanks to you _(again!)_ , we hit our April fundraising goal! This was our first fundraising goal since our primary, and hitting the target means a lot to the team and me. Dark money, right-wing groups are already running attack ads against me, and we need the resources to fight back.

Look, these extreme Republicans have a hell of a lot of money to put behind these attacks. They’re backed by huge corporations and shady PACs. But I rely on grassroots folks like you Derek to make this a winning campaign. It’s how I won in 2022, and I know that we can win again with your support.

So thank you again for being a part of this team. I couldn’t do it without you.

Thanks,

Convention, Candidates, and Signatures

|
#
Peter -- Convention, Candidates, and Signatures
## **Join us at our biggest event yet.**
[](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u2f82VcN49yJ3Wou-X6QZ0iX7Wo282dwEVAVW2OXhRwp9nFWgJUYIxm1C0IOL0s56czjj0_b1t4xvpmls2l_Pm8&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_2024_newsletter&n=1) One of the best days since the forming of the PA Forward Party was May 20, 2023 when we had our first PA Forward Summit. We took huge organizational steps and met many people in person for the first time. Many things have changed since then. We've had affiliation events and even got our first Forwardist in office. We've had new supporters, volunteers, and leaders join our ranks. Now, as we work towards what is by far, our most ambitious election season since we started, please join us to look to the future. We've sometimes been referred to as a group for the politically homeless. That won't feel true when you're with so many people working to build a place we can all call home. **Where:** Gettysburg Hilton Garden Inn
1061 York Road
Gettysburg, PA 17325 **When:** June 1st, 2024 - 10am - 6pm Lunch and drink are included with the $30 ticket price. | [](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u2f82VcN49yJ3Wou-X6QZ0iX7Wo282dwEVAVW2OXhRwp9nFWgJUYIxm1C0IOL0s56czjj0_b1t4xvpmls2l_Pm8&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_2024_newsletter&n=2 "2024 Convention Info") [2024 Convention Info](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u2f82VcN49yJ3Wou-X6QZ0iX7Wo282dwEVAVW2OXhRwp9nFWgJUYIxm1C0IOL0s56czjj0_b1t4xvpmls2l_Pm8&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_2024_newsletter&n=2)
---
* * *
## **Supporting Candidates that Support Voters**
****
We hope everyone has had a chance to learn about our two 2024 State wide candidates, [Eric Settle for Attorney General](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=6BLvcs9L8yKeLlDDfRfHz66rlo1d_loCa5GiY0skVkU&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_2024_newsletter&n=3) and [Chris Foster for Treasurer](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=Y8t8yI0vnsVOJ_3ABaT08b-c3VZ5Gq00HFnYcc-dwKiZVk8IPPsgh78Qasf9cDhl&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_2024_newsletter&n=4). Eric and Chris are doing a great job getting the word out about what we're doing and we're proud to have them represent us at the top of the PA ballot this year.
We were so excited to have an [event this month](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=wJe7Oi2KXzCNE6T3sSKybawz_lfTKbLwknrwqOhoCWHgGYWzNZaXONp0wlNheBFehwKqMQnVrRGsb6yOmXA6AY-pk4dfbuOlcHJPlHzxtylS5QrYZHz0dB0-H8p8dTCi&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_2024_newsletter&n=5) affiliating with Cameron Schroy. Andrew Yang joined our statewide candidates in Gettysburg to back Cameron in his attempt to defeat Doug Mastriano. Cameron is proud to be a Forward Democrat and will represent us well.
We've also endorsed John Mamatas for House district 32 in Eastern Allegheny County. He's new to politics and we're proud to work with John in his attempt to give his district a choice this November and prevent the seat from being filled by party insiders.
These are just some of the candidates we'll be working with this year. If you know of someone we should work with, please let us know or just have the candidate fill out [this Form](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=sojKb_wtkPPdAcBGoK_VqwfXJVYPfXvj3kNPN-uZbZt-cFp6d7I1ytGGgacq76Vi8lpzpBU3TQxwu3xlg1MwZQ&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_2024_newsletter&n=6).
* * *
## **All Our Hard Work Relies on Signatures**
****
We've all put a lot of time and effort to get our party in the place we're in. This November, every Pennsylvanian can have at least 2 Forward Party candidates on their ballot and we can be a recognized Minor Party all across the state. Whether that happens or not depends on all of us collecting the signatures to get these candidates on the ballot.
Our initial goal is to collect at least 5000 signatures by mid June. That is fewer Pennsylvanians than we currently have in our email lists so we should absolutely be able to reach this number - but we need YOUR help. We had a great start on Primary Day and need to keep up the effort. We have about a dozen volunteers currently collecting signatures across the state. If you have spent more than a few hours wondering how you can help, this is your moment.
If you are not able to help as a Signature Gatherer, please reach out to your Regional Chair to make a plan to meet up and sign onto Papers for your county. Your signature alone helps us toward our goal.
Ben- b8a8v1@yahoo.com
Kristine- olliesmom2014@gmail.com
## Wanted: Website Manager
We have a new website, please check it out.
[PA Forward Party](https://home.forwardparty.com/r?u=MtBLw57MCBnd28lIl741u6XwRhvsem01hvYMbSFzm2g&e=61868e7acdd36ae0ddf3e39aa8429171&utm_source=forwardparty&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=may_2024_newsletter&n=7)
It's still a work in progress but it's a big step up from the very basic one we have been using. If you have technical experience with building out websites and have been looking for a chance to help out, please let us know.
Join us May 20th at 8pm for our Monthly Statewide call to talk about Convention, Candidates, and Signatures.

clean_body: Convention, Candidates, and Signatures | Peter -- Convention, Candidates, and Signatures Join us at our biggest event yet. One of the best days since the forming of the PA Forward Party was May 20, 2023 when we had our first PA Forward Summit. We took huge organizational steps and met many people in person for the first time. Many things have changed since then. We've had affiliation events and even got our first Forwardist in office. We've had new supporters, volunteers, and leaders join our ranks. Now, as we work towards what is by far, our most ambitious election season since we started, please join us to look to the future. We've sometimes been referred to as a group for the politically homeless. That won't feel true when you're with so many people working to build a place we can all call home. Where: Gettysburg Hilton Garden Inn 1061 York Road Gettysburg, PA 17325 When: June 1st, 2024 - 10am - 6pm Lunch and drink are included with the $30 ticket price. | "2024 Convention Info" Supporting Candidates that Support Voters We hope everyone has had a chance to learn about our two 2024 State wide candidates, and . Eric and Chris are doing a great job getting the word out about what we're doing and we're proud to have them represent us at the top of the PA ballot this year. We were so excited to have an affiliating with Cameron Schroy. Andrew Yang joined our statewide candidates in Gettysburg to back Cameron in his attempt to defeat Doug Mastriano. Cameron is proud to be a Forward Democrat and will represent us well. We've also endorsed John Mamatas for House district 32 in Eastern Allegheny County. He's new to politics and we're proud to work with John in his attempt to give his district a choice this November and prevent the seat from being filled by party insiders. These are just some of the candidates we'll be working with this year. If you know of someone we should work with, please let us know or just have the candidate fill out . All Our Hard Work Relies on Signatures ** We've all put a lot of time and effort to get our party in the place we're in. This November, every Pennsylvanian can have at least 2 Forward Party candidates on their ballot and we can be a recognized Minor Party all across the state. Whether that happens or not depends on all of us collecting the signatures to get these candidates on the ballot. Our initial goal is to collect at least 5000 signatures by mid June. That is fewer Pennsylvanians than we currently have in our email lists so we should absolutely be able to reach this number - but we need YOUR help. We had a great start on Primary Day and need to keep up the effort. We have about a dozen volunteers currently collecting signatures across the state. If you have spent more than a few hours wondering how you can help, this is your moment. If you are not able to help as a Signature Gatherer, please reach out to your Regional Chair to make a plan to meet up and sign onto Papers for your county. Your signature alone helps us toward our goal. Ben- b8a8v1@yahoo.com Kristine- olliesmom2014@gmail.com Wanted: Website Manager We have a new website, please check it out. It's still a work in progress but it's a big step up from the very basic one we have been using. If you have technical experience with building out websites and have been looking for a chance to help out, please let us know. Join us May 20th at 8pm for our Monthly Statewide call to talk about Convention, Candidates, and Signatures. Click below to read the articles**** Here are our other goals for 2024: We will run a Statewide Candidate who wins 2% of the statewide total. We will run several State House Candidates in the hopes of winning enough to prevent either of the major parties from achieving a majority. We will build our volunteer base across the Commonwealth. We will identify & develop leaders at the Regional & County levels. We will dramatically increase the number of monthly donors. Click the event above to join the meeting. Don't forget to check out our new Calendar of Events and bookmark it so you never miss a call again. You can view it by "Calendar of Events" Pennsylvania Forward Party -=-=- Forward Party · 1701 Rhode Island Ave NW, Washington, DC 20036, United States

Peter,

I want to give you and every member of this incredible grassroots movement
a huge THANK YOU.

As you know, Justice Democrats and our allies spent the last few weeks
committed to raising $100,000 before the end of April for the five most
vulnerable members of the Squad being attacked by Republican
megadonor-funded groups like AIPAC.

I’m thrilled to share: we did it!

In about three weeks across more than ten progressive organizations, we
surpassed our goal and raised over $130,000 for Jamaal Bowman, Cori Bush,
Summer Lee, Ilhan Omar, and Rashida Tlaib. That’s people power.

None of these Squad members (or any Justice Democrats candidate) takes
money from corporate super PACs, so your donations will truly make a
difference in fueling their re-election fights.

With AIPAC’s network of super PACs threatening to spend $100 million
against the Squad in an attempt to unseat them and stop our momentum this
election year, we are coming together as a movement to protect the few
progressive champions in Congress truly fighting for us instead of
corporate interests.

So far, we helped Summer Lee win her Democratic primary against a GOP
billionaire-backed opponent in a landslide last month. Now, our next
primary is coming up in less than two months in New York, where Jamaal
will go up against an out-of-touch, moderate, career politician who’s
received more than $1 million from AIPAC.

Again, I can’t thank you enough for all you’ve contributed to Justice
Democrats and our bloc of diverse, young, working-class progressives so
far this cycle.

Our work is far from over, but we’ve already stopped AIPAC from succeeding
in their goal of ousting every Squad member from Congress this year. Let’s
keep it up, protect the rest of our incumbents, and continue building our
power.

In solidarity,

Alexandra Rojas
Executive Director

subject: 🔎 Issue spotlight: Hidden fees

body:
freedomva.org [freedomva.org]
Friends-
Part of our story campaign will be focused on highlighting our priority issues! We made great progress on these issues during the recent legislative session. We will continue to fight for these issues next year so we want to make sure our supporters know all about them.
Hidden fees are exactly how they sound. A fee tacked onto a purchase that wasn’t disclosed at the beginning of the transaction. This can apply to all areas of life. Famously hidden fees are used when purchasing concert tickets, but did you know they can show up on everything from rental cars to electricity bills? Studies have shown that consumers faced with these hidden fees can pay upward of twenty percent more than they would have had the actual price been disclosed upfront.
Hidden fees can impact anyone at any point, but it’s an issue that people don’t seem to talk about. This is where storytelling comes in.
As an organizer, I believe storytelling shows the humanity and faces behind the facts of the issues we work on, making it harder for our lawmakers to look away. It puts us all on an equal playing field and is an accessible way for anyone of any walk of life to advocate beyond people who work in the field.
If you have experience with the issue of hidden fees, we’d love to hear from you!
You can fill out our form here:
Share your story [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSd1corcX24sU8SGyHsLsdf0sOYMn0IUnWer5EUKDjaPTcrszw/viewform?usp=sf_link]
Thank you for lending your voice to this issue!

clean_body: freedomva.org [freedomva.org] Friends- Part of our story campaign will be focused on highlighting our priority issues! We made great progress on these issues during the recent legislative session. We will continue to fight for these issues next year so we want to make sure our supporters know all about them. Hidden fees are exactly how they sound. A fee tacked onto a purchase that wasn’t disclosed at the beginning of the transaction. This can apply to all areas of life. Famously hidden fees are used when purchasing concert tickets, but did you know they can show up on everything from rental cars to electricity bills? Studies have shown that consumers faced with these hidden fees can pay upward of twenty percent more than they would have had the actual price been disclosed upfront. Hidden fees can impact anyone at any point, but it’s an issue that people don’t seem to talk about. This is where storytelling comes in. As an organizer, I believe storytelling shows the humanity and faces behind the facts of the issues we work on, making it harder for our lawmakers to look away. It puts us all on an equal playing field and is an accessible way for anyone of any walk of life to advocate beyond people who work in the field. If you have experience with the issue of hidden fees, we’d love to hear from you! You can fill out our form here: Share your story [] Thank you for lending your voice to this issue! name: Sarah McBride
subject: If it ain’t broken, why fix it?
body:
Last summer, I kicked off our canvassing efforts and I did so at the very first door I knocked on nearly five years ago when I launched my first campaign for the State Senate!
#
Honestly, I am not usually superstitious, but during a campaign, _if it ain’t broken, then why fix it?_ Plus, who really wants to tempt fate? **It’s campaigns 101.**
Last summer, I kicked off our canvassing efforts and I did so at the very first door I knocked on nearly five years ago when I launched my first campaign for the State Senate!
**At that house, I met Lynne and Greg. They’re an amazing couple — passionate about change and our great state.**
I’m lucky to call Lynne and Greg supporters more than four years (and a few campaigns) later. And when I knocked on their door, I got a hard commitment — another campaigns 101.
**Lynne and Greg are ready to help me reach voters up and down the state. Will you join them? Here are two key ways you can support our campaign today:**
1. **Sign up now to volunteer:** There are only a few months left until Election Day, and we need your help to spread the word by knocking on doors, phone banking, and text banking. **We've already had hundreds of volunteers join us in the last few weeks!** [**Click here to commit to volunteer and our team will reach out shortly!**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/go/157?t=1&akid=248%2E21716%2E03DQ4U)

2. **Donate now:** Every. Single. Dollar. goes a long way to help our team hire field organizers, communicate with voters, and much, much more! [**You can make a donation of any amount by clicking here.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/mcb-em-20240502?refcode=em20240502-1-248&refcode2=248_21716_03DQ4U&akid=248%2E21716%2E03DQ4U)

**Every little bit helps, and together we can show that small states can do big things!**
Thanks for your support,
\- Sarah

name: Tina Smith
subject: Two years ago, Politico released the leaked SCOTUS opinion that overturned Roe v. Wade. Here’s what’s happened since
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Tina Smith for Minnesota
body:
In the last two years, we’ve seen a relentless attack on women’s rights. |
#
Folks, Two years ago, _Politico_ released the leaked Supreme Court opinion that overturned _Roe v. Wade_. Just a few weeks later, the decision was confirmed in the disastrous ruling in _Dobbs v. Jackson_. Here’s what’s happened since then:
* Dozens of states have eliminated protections for abortions, forcing women to travel across state lines to receive the care they need.

* GOP legislators and conservative judges have come after medication abortion, the doctors who perform abortions, in-vitro fertilization (IVF), and other forms of reproductive healthcare.

* Donald Trump has doubled down on his radical stances on abortion. His campaign team is _already_ drafting executive orders to repeal abortion access if he makes it back to the White House.

in this picture to the U.S. Senate. But first, let me explain:

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2764?c0=may2024_abs_em.daySKu&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240502_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1006&akid=6376%2E5257348%2E-Aqyf9 ]DONATE $2

One of the unique cases I took on as a young prosecutor involved a
corporation that hired toxic waste haulers to smuggle hazardous materials
across the border into Mexico.

The U.S. government had just put in place additional environmental rules
to protect our drinking water and our communities. This made it harder to
dump chemicals and toxic waste in the U.S. and was critical for water
safety.

A company paid the haulers to smuggle the waste across the border and dump
it in Mexico. We found dozens of drums that used to carry this hazardous
waste there, from paints to flammable solvents and other toxic materials.

We also intercepted a fair amount of other cargo intended to be dumped.
Unfortunately, people living in these areas emptied the drums, filled them
with water, and washed clothes in them, among other unknowingly dangerous
uses.

As an Assistant U.S. Attorney, I took on this waste dumping corporation —
and won.

It was the first federal prosecution for across-the-border toxic waste
dumping ever. It set an important precedent: that no company, big or
small, could avoid accountability when harming our planet and putting the
health of communities at risk, at home or abroad.

Back to the present: pitching in $2, or any amount you can spare, can help
us have the resources to get me to the U.S. Senate — where I will continue
to hold any corporations polluting our planet accountable.

[ https://act.adamschiff.com/go/2764?c0=may2024_abs_em.daySKu&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_GEN_AC90_20240502_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=1007&akid=6376%2E5257348%2E-Aqyf9 ]So please, if you can, will you pitch in $2 or more today to help me
make it to the Senate to help pass important legislation to protect our
planet, create more green jobs, and build cleaner infrastructure?

Peter, defending democracy and freedom, expanding opportunity and fairness, and meeting the climate crisis aren't just the words of a campaign for me. They've been the story of my life. That story began in a small upstairs apartment, where I watched my immigrant parents work so hard yet struggle to make ends meet. But because America welcomed immigrants — and with help from public schools and Pell Grants — I grew from a kid whose parents didn’t speak much English to working in the White House. I worked with President Clinton to pass the first balanced budget in 30 years, with Al Gore to sound the alarm early on global warming, and with President Obama to protect consumers and transform our healthcare system. I served our nation in uniform after 9/11, and I took on the big banks after they caused the financial crisis. I built a company that helped families avoid unfair bank fees and that treated its workers right. When _Roe v. Wade_ was overturned, I ensured that every one of our employees would have access to reproductive health services even if they lived in a state where abortion was banned. Friend, did you see Donald Trump’s interview in TIME Magazine this week?
* He said he would allow states to prosecute and punish women seeking reproductive health care.
* He said he would allow states to invade women’s privacy and _monitor their pregnancies._
* And he wouldn’t rule out signing a national abortion ban or legislation banning IVF.

Donald Trump and extremist Republicans are doing everything they can to take away a woman’s right to decide if, when and how she can have children.
Bodily autonomy and right to privacy are on the ballot this November. **That’s why we _need_ to do everything we can to keep the Senate blue this fall: So we can hold our Democratic majority and defend our reproductive rights. This is the only way we can stop a national ban and codify Roe v. Wade.**
