If you didn’t know, before I began my term as the Chair of our party, I traveled from state to state organizing communications workers as the Field Director for the Communications Workers of America. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84210548/470807207/1732376468?refcode=AU_AZD_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240502_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzgwZjk2NWQtYzgwOC1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PQneRt7_Cy1dwFOvyhqbqyQy7rz4UHQ9LNxgXhZyEv0=&emci=9e929b79-c308-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=c80f965d-c808-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=9307116) I got my start with CWA as a union steward. As a call center employee for 17 years, I knew the importance of a strong union, how it can enhance workplace protections and ensure that workers are protected from violations by their employers. Everyone deserves the protection of a union — and the Protecting the Right to Organize Act will help to ensure that organizers can do the work it takes to build strong unions in every industry. **[Add your name to our petition right now to strengthen support for the PRO Act in Glendale.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84210550/470807209/1732376468?refcode=AU_AZD_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240502_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzgwZjk2NWQtYzgwOC1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PQneRt7_Cy1dwFOvyhqbqyQy7rz4UHQ9LNxgXhZyEv0=&emci=9e929b79-c308-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=c80f965d-c808-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=9307116)** | [SIGN ON](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84210552/470807211/1732376468?refcode=AU_AZD_EG_GEN_PET_AC90_20240502_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS8xMDU1MTYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYzgwZjk2NWQtYzgwOC1lZjExLTk2ZjMtN2MxZTUyMWIwN2Y5IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=PQneRt7_Cy1dwFOvyhqbqyQy7rz4UHQ9LNxgXhZyEv0=&emci=9e929b79-c308-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=c80f965d-c808-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=9307116)

You want tangible proof that electing more young leaders can accelerate progress and stop us from moving backward? **Just look at the work Delegate Nadarius Clark, our very first elected candidate, is doing in Virginia:**

name: Jena Griswold
subject: Re: Deepfakes
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Jena for Colorado
body:
AI technology is used to create deepfakes by manipulating a person’s actions or speech. Deepfakes can be used to effectively spread disinformation. Coloradans deserve to know when the content they are consuming is real and when it has been altered by AI. | | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84211793/470810067/-432624105?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82OTk1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZWFlNzM0Zi1jYjA4LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Lk5yGlqUfYXUiw_6aJ22vnCRTiF6_tm2WO5XOr6rR4c=&emci=1aae734f-cb08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=2eae734f-cb08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=22121989) Friends, AI technology is used to create deepfakes by manipulating a person’s actions or speech. Deepfakes can be used to effectively spread disinformation. Coloradans deserve to know when the content they are consuming is real and when it has been altered by AI. One of my legislative priorities is a bill that requires deepfakes and AI-generated media that feature Colorado candidates or officeholders have disclaimers so Coloradans know they may not be real. AI generated communications without a disclaimer will be subject to campaign finance enforcement and penalties, and the featured person would have a private right of action to sue those responsible for the communication. My fellow Secretaries of State are also working to confront this challenge. From public education campaigns to rapid-response communications, our elections are in good hands when Secretaries of State take action. [**Read this _Politico_ article to learn more about how Secretaries of State across the country are tackling AI head-on.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84211795/470810069/1785909966?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82OTk1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZWFlNzM0Zi1jYjA4LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Lk5yGlqUfYXUiw_6aJ22vnCRTiF6_tm2WO5XOr6rR4c=&emci=1aae734f-cb08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=2eae734f-cb08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=22121989) Thank you, Jena Griswold **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84211796/470810070/452015706?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82OTk1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZWFlNzM0Zi1jYjA4LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Lk5yGlqUfYXUiw_6aJ22vnCRTiF6_tm2WO5XOr6rR4c=&emci=1aae734f-cb08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=2eae734f-cb08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=22121989) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84211797/470810071/-1930142840?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82OTk1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZWFlNzM0Zi1jYjA4LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Lk5yGlqUfYXUiw_6aJ22vnCRTiF6_tm2WO5XOr6rR4c=&emci=1aae734f-cb08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=2eae734f-cb08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=22121989) [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84211798/470810072/221440929?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82OTk1NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyZWFlNzM0Zi1jYjA4LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Lk5yGlqUfYXUiw_6aJ22vnCRTiF6_tm2WO5XOr6rR4c=&emci=1aae734f-cb08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=2eae734f-cb08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=22121989)** Paid for by Jena for Colorado. body:
Take a look to see what he said he plans on doing if elected to another term:
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84212056/470810742/41798106?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84Nzk3MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2NTNjNjlkZS1jYjA4LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=M44tvcScKrNxecy68DdeMzLHbiw1e7MQ493UFNyrA20=&emci=491c4f54-9d08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=653c69de-cb08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=26261389)

| | Donald Trump is planning his next reign of terror, and he's spelling it out clearly for all to see. In a recent interview with Time Magazine, Trump laid out his second-term destructive agenda. **Here's a glimpse at a potentially terrifying future if Trump wins the White House:**
* Trump would let red states monitor women's pregnancies and prosecute those who violate abortion bans.
* He would green-light a mass deportation program to remove more than 11 million people from the country, and said he would be willing to build migrant detention camps.
* He would be willing to fire a U.S. Attorney who doesn't carry out his order to prosecute someone.
* He is weighing pardons for every one of his supporters accused of attacking the U.S. Capitol on Jan. 6, 2021.
* He would gut the U.S. civil service, deploy the National Guard to American cities as he sees fit, close the White House pandemic-preparedness office, and staff his Administration with acolytes who back his false assertion that the 2020 election was stolen.

name: Debbie Mucarsel-Powell
subject: the beginning of the end [of the right to choose]
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Debbie for Florida
body:
Two years ago today —
| | |
---
Dear friend,
Two years ago today, _Politico_ published a leaked draft of the Dobbs decision, marking the beginning of the end of the federal right to an abortion.
By June, the far-right majority on the U.S. Supreme Court would overturn nearly 50 years of protections for abortion and reproductive health care, triggering an avalanche of cruel, deadly bans across the United States — including right here in Florida.
In its wake, our right to choose, to privacy in the doctor's office, and to self-determination are no longer guaranteed. They now depend on which state a person calls home, whether they can afford to leave, and whether medical providers are willing to take the legal risks that may arise from doing their job.
**And two years ago today, Florida Republicans Florida Republicans like Rick Scott rejoiced.**
For years, the Sunshine State was a safe space for abortion access across the South, thanks to the right to privacy granted in our state constitution.
But when Gov. Ron DeSantis took power, he shaped our state Supreme Court in his vision of an extreme far-right Florida. They upheld his already-illegal 15-week ban, and by ruling 6-1 against statewide protections for abortion rights, they greenlit his stricter six-week trigger ban.
Look, Florida already ranks #2 in deaths due to complications from pregnancy or childbirth among the states. Black Floridians are three times as likely to die in childbirth or from related complications.
And under this new law — which took effect just yesterday — Floridians seeking abortions in the first trimester now face some of the strictest requirements of any ban nationwide.
Some will be forced to travel 14 hours or more to receive abortion care. Some will be turned away from doctors' offices in the event of a life-threatening medical emergency. **Some Floridians will die.**
And this dangerous new reality we're now living under was only possible thanks to what happened two years ago today.
Yet in spite of a supermajority of Florida voters in favor of the ballot initiative to reinstate abortion rights — including 53% of Republicans — our senator, Rick Scott, has made passing a nationwide ban on abortions his #1 mission in Washington.
Like so many Latinos, I know what it means to have your freedoms stripped by authoritarian leaders who want to control every aspect of your life. My family came to America to escape those authoritarians —**so I refuse to stand back and watch as they try to take over here.**
**I refuse to let authoritarian laws like these risk the lives of Florida's mothers and the future of Florida's families.**
**And I refuse to let extremists like Ron DeSantis and Rick Scott take away rights from me, my daughters, or yours.**
**I say _enough is enough —_ that's why I'm running to retire Rick Scott. Rick Scott has proudly backed the 6-week ban and a national abortion ban. And as I travel statewide to spread the word about this movement, one of my top priorities is to make sure Floridians know about our opportunity to take back the right to choose from GOP authoritarians this November.**
I vow to never stop fighting until reproductive freedoms are enjoyed by every Floridian, and every American, once more.
And friend, I hope I can count on you in the fight with me.
Thanks for reading,

Debbie

They upheld his already-illegal 15-week ban, and by ruling 6-1 against statewide protections for abortion rights, they greenlit his stricter six-week trigger ban. Look, Florida already ranks #2 in deaths due to complications from pregnancy or childbirth among the states. Black Floridians are three times as likely to die in childbirth or from related complications. And under this new law — which took effect just yesterday — Floridians seeking abortions in the first trimester now face some of the strictest requirements of any ban nationwide. Some will be forced to travel 14 hours or more to receive abortion care. Some will be turned away from doctors' offices in the event of a life-threatening medical emergency. Some Floridians will die. And this dangerous new reality we're now living under was only possible thanks to what happened two years ago today. Yet in spite of a supermajority of Florida voters in favor of the ballot initiative to reinstate abortion rights — including 53% of Republicans — our senator, Rick Scott, has made passing a nationwide ban on abortions his #1 mission in Washington. Like so many Latinos, I know what it means to have your freedoms stripped by authoritarian leaders who want to control every aspect of your life. My family came to America to escape those authoritarians —so I refuse to stand back and watch as they try to take over here. I refuse to let authoritarian laws like these risk the lives of Florida's mothers and the future of Florida's families. And I refuse to let extremists like Ron DeSantis and Rick Scott take away rights from me, my daughters, or yours. I say enough is enough — that's why I'm running to retire Rick Scott. Rick Scott has proudly backed the 6-week ban and a national abortion ban. And as I travel statewide to spread the word about this movement, one of my top priorities is to make sure Floridians know about our opportunity to take back the right to choose from GOP authoritarians this November. I vow to never stop fighting until reproductive freedoms are enjoyed by every Floridian, and every American, once more. And friend, I hope I can count on you in the fight with me. Thanks for reading, Debbie | * | | | = Debbie Mucarsel-Powell is a Floridian, South American immigrant, mother, and former Congresswoman. She’s dedicated her life to uplifting working families, ending gun violence, and fighting for her community. Now, she’s running to defeat Republican Senator Rick Scott and win a better, brighter future for Florida.

name: Becca Balint
subject: May is Mental Health Awareness Month
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Becca Balint for Vermont
body:
To anyone out there who is struggling: I see you, I love you, and I’m fighting for you. You matter.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84213167/470814840/966991095?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MTU3OGRkZC1jZjA4LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UEiqj7lRCar-5IET30o57wgsbTFJav563rZkuh_hluQ=&emci=0591949c-ca08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=81578ddd-cf08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=43402272) | Hi Peter, May is Mental Health Awareness Month. To anyone out there who is struggling: I see you, I love you, and I’m fighting for you. You matter.
* **If you or someone you love is experiencing a mental health crisis, please do not hesitate to call or text the suicide and crisis lifeline at 988.** The 988 lifeline is available 24/7 and is completely free and confidential.

* This month, please join me in setting aside time to read [_**the 988 lifeline’s resources**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84213168/470814841/1742213756?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4MTU3OGRkZC1jZjA4LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UEiqj7lRCar-5IET30o57wgsbTFJav563rZkuh_hluQ=&emci=0591949c-ca08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&emdi=81578ddd-cf08-ef11-96f3-7c1e521b07f9&ceid=43402272) on how to help a loved one who may be in crisis. This information can save lives.

Peter, acknowledging mental illness doesn’t make you weak; it makes you human. When we speak openly about it, we give others permission and courage to also speak openly and promote healing. That’s why I’m committed to being open about my own struggles while fighting for legislation in Congress that expands access to mental health care and improves resources for teens. This month and always, don’t forget to be kind to your fellow humans. You never know what someone else is going through. With love, Becca
---

clean_body: To anyone out there who is struggling: I see you, I love you, and I’m fighting for you. You matter. | | Hi Peter, May is Mental Health Awareness Month. To anyone out there who is struggling: I see you, I love you, and I’m fighting for you. You matter. If you or someone you love is experiencing a mental health crisis, please do not hesitate to call or text the suicide and crisis lifeline at 988. The 988 lifeline is available 24/7 and is completely free and confidential. This month, please join me in setting aside time to read on how to help a loved one who may be in crisis. This information can save lives. Peter, acknowledging mental illness doesn’t make you weak; it makes you human. When we speak openly about it, we give others permission and courage to also speak openly and promote healing. That’s why I’m committed to being open about my own struggles while fighting for legislation in Congress that expands access to mental health care and improves resources for teens. This month and always, don’t forget to be kind to your fellow humans. You never know what someone else is going through. **BREAKING: A federal three-judge panel struck down Louisiana’s congressional map, which contains two Black-opportunity districts as required by Section 2 of the Voting Rights Act** The court’s ruling unnecessarily puts Louisianians’ right to vote in a very precarious position. This decision is a radical departure from multiple recent court decisions regarding Louisiana’s congressional map. It is so wildly out of step from settled law and recent Supreme Court precedent that the ideological nature of the decision could not be more clear. Since the Voting Rights Act was enacted, anti-democracy forces have sought to minimize its effectiveness. The fight for equal representation is both historic and ongoing. **This decision harkens back to a dark time in our nation’s history. Undaunted, we will continue the fight for fairness and equality.** **Louisiana’s current, fair maps — which gives Black Louisianians their long denied but rightful voting power — should remain in place for 2024 and for every future election.** As this case proceeds, other courts must ensure that our march to justice continues, that precedent is respected and that the fundamental rights of all American citizens are upheld. **Eric H. It is so wildly out of step from settled law and recent Supreme Court precedent that the ideological nature of the decision could not be more clear. **Great news, Peter: AG Letitia James has been fighting nonstop to ensure workers are paid fairly under New York law.**
AG James is a champion for workers’ rights, getting us closer to establishing fair wages, safe working conditions, and proper treatment in the workplace.

And after the 1864 ban is repealed, a 15-week abortion ban supported by my opponent will take effect. Let’s be clear: this is still an unacceptable infringement on women’s reproductive rights — one I will fight to end in Congress. My opponent vetted the Arizona Supreme Court judges who voted in favor of the barbaric 1864 ban. He celebrated on social media when Roe v. Wade was overturned. Tom is the proud husband to Rhonda and the proud father to two beautiful daughters. Their family resides in the wonderful city of Westfield, New Jersey. Tom's commitment to the people of New Jersey has been inspired by a legacy of **dedicated public service** from his grandfather, former U.S. Representative Robert Kean, to his father, former Governor Thomas H. Kean Sr. Kean has always understood and recognized the importance of civic engagement and is honored to **represent the people of New Jersey's 7th Congressional District** in Congress. From his early days in the Environmental Protection Agency during the George H.W. Bush Administration (where he met his incredible wife Rhonda), to serving as a volunteer firefighter and an emergency medical technician in Washington, D.C. — Tom has always had a heart for making our world a better, freer, safer place. Determined to answer the call to public service again, Tom Kean Jr. believed he, personally, could turn ideas into action and make a lasting difference in people’s lives. In 2001, Tom was elected to the New Jersey General Assembly, and two years later, was named to the upper house of the state legislature after his tireless work in ethics reform. Then in 2008, his peers unanimously elected him Republican Leader in the New Jersey Senate. Shortly thereafter, he unveiled his caucus’ job creation package, **“Common-Sense Plan for a More Affordable New Jersey,”** which ultimately reversed the course that previous administrations were quickly leading the state down. To this day, Tom continues to build upon his proven track record of delivering for the people of New Jersey in Congress:
* **Passed legislation advocating for Veteran-Owned small businesses**
* **Passed legislation to improve commuter rail transportation**
* **Passed a resolution affirming strong US support for Ukraine**
* **Passed legislation to support mental health for school children**

Fellow American,

As one of my top supporters, I wanted to give you an update about recent developments in our Arizona Senate campaign.

**First:** Independent Senator Kyrsten Sinema dropped out, leaving the race a one-on-one contest between myself and radical leftist Ruben Gallego.

**Then:** Left-wing donors and activist groups donated **over $1 million** to Gallego's campaign in just 24 hours. He raised $7.5 MILLION last quarter!

**Now:** I'm launching a fundraising blitz to fight back and make sure we have the resources we need to win this race, flip the Senate, and save America.

| [**CHIP IN NOW TO HELP ME FIGHT BACK** ](http://links.electionsupdates.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=ef0f171c08fd492c8733f46893b4394c&_e=UVXyh--XqSJ-ZqsLVrIurXSrozrqyfu8HICUOCLO213G-gPqQfkB1S7A1D8qmBcQHFsTaBSplBKvVjLBivehPPx8EX1E2gS2RoPj6I8RAL2fabgUuMf3ln32aGV5HzF9xzdmJKyJqb_zhGs3tfxwb5bMccRIEdY8rJSjbwBa4yly5ROLQPtMB4XJki7kW7Xssw6no8vl0E_GkzJB_dUWvAPs8MWkm9qWRLN1L5n6SJo2FGkNvINwqwv6nffLYZJYSE2Vz_OaiMh2bFvpJAKTENr8K_Nfn6YROJgByP4hvYlT4FTQAPhEzUr8ByVop93udYDcuBwglFAerLtB6feQuv8qv_yfo2RovcBwnzANjkRPOAubCWpvuWxaGXfDn5fa--FurH5wCb_g92GvfGJXnQYNqu7AxuM85uOMtXdfa7E%3D)

The road to the Senate majority goes through Arizona. There's simply no way for Republicans to flip the Senate unless we win here. That means if we fall short, we can say goodbye to a secure border, a strong economy, and safe streets.

The good news is polling shows we have the lead. The bad news is with my opponent's massive windfall of cash, and the fake news doing his bidding, our momentum could stall if we don't act fast.

I don't have millionaire liberals from New York and California bankrolling my campaign. I'm relying on grassroots conservative patriots who are sick and tired of what Joe Biden and his cronies have done to our great country. Peter, the AANHPI community is diverse – and yet our stories share common threads: _of struggle, community and resilience_. Today, I’d like to take a minute to share my family’s story and **I hope you take the time to read it.**

Pictured below are my maternal and paternal grandparents:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84215747/470824629/311580727?amount=7&refcode=MTFC_20240502_EMDF_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OTViYjI4Zi1kOTA4LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7lM2Lc_kqesZRcdCr945Cnu2Dr17dDMBPuyfFU93ArA=) | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84215748/470824630/311580727?amount=7&refcode=MTFC_20240502_EMDF_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OTViYjI4Zi1kOTA4LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7lM2Lc_kqesZRcdCr945Cnu2Dr17dDMBPuyfFU93ArA=)
---|---
Painfully, along with my parents,**they were all sent to Japanese American internment camps** during World War II because of racist, fear-mongering policies. They lost everything. Meanwhile, my Great Uncle Mon _sacrificed his life_ serving in the US army during World War II.

These policies were a continuation of a long history of _Asian exclusion and discrimination in US history._ **Nonetheless, we’ve persevered.** My family started over and rebuilt their entire lives after the internment camps – not unlike many other AANHPI and immigrant communities who fought to pursue the American Dream and build a new, better life for their children.

Today, I’m feeling especially thankful for my parents, Nancy – who I miss everyday – and Willie, for everything they sacrificed for me and my brothers, pictured here:
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84215749/470824631/311580727?amount=7&refcode=MTFC_20240502_EMDF_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OTViYjI4Zi1kOTA4LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7lM2Lc_kqesZRcdCr945Cnu2Dr17dDMBPuyfFU93ArA=)
Peter, I’m proud to be Asian American. The AANHPI community has persevered and thrived in the United States. And it means so much to me that our nation is collectively celebrating and acknowledging AANHPI history, contributions, and culture.

**After all, Asian American history _is_ American history. **

[**Peter, as one of a small handful of Asian Americans serving in Congress, I’m proud to be a voice for AANHPI communities and other underrepresented groups. If you support my work, would you chip in $7 or any amount to help me keep up my work for the AANHPI community? »**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/84215750/470824632/311580727?amount=7&refcode=MTFC_20240502_EMDF_E1_T0_AC&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDM2MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4OTViYjI4Zi1kOTA4LWVmMTEtOTZmMy03YzFlNTIxYjA3ZjkiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=7lM2Lc_kqesZRcdCr945Cnu2Dr17dDMBPuyfFU93ArA=)

Friend -- Those of us who have been out collecting signatures for ballot access have noticed that the American people are on edge -- nearly hysterical in many cases. Between the multiple wars, the genocide in Gaza, and the hyperinflation here at home, with the Congress launching a full on assault on freedom of speech and association, the future is indeed in doubt. Only one western politicial figure accurately forecast that this is exactly the crisis we would face, if no American president changed the fateful trajectory we've been on at least since the assassination of President John F. Kennedy. That figure was Lyndon LaRouche, who was also vilified and finally jailed by his political adversaries. I am looking forward to having my friend and collaborator Megan Dobrodt with me on Friday night. She has just completed preparing the second volume of LaRouche's writings for release, and we will be discussing the content of his work on music, poetry and statecraft. Treat yourself to something other than extreme hysteria, and tune in tomorrow night at 7:00 pm.

body:
Please read this full message
[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=12351d47df0244b3be4aa54e0c7492d2&_e=LgDdj1VaGZ40jR7EzFktitt2wNHKkSqv3J4DII_jpZcllJ-FegsjONQKl1tZDQTy_RlL6gevK5_oxbZnn7gbdbV-R3xmwrhQPZwy5732sUym4PYoVhBuHeb50ktcJdacOv4n-G8XCSSvGTyoZUxbRXi10GHYT7fMMIrvAQonqJ7JLSs8TMRmZ6ge7ILquFnL5kESu7ytzijmk4AT3i3WZUcPpTNW7ZHglzO82P3JTXKSgPccAfKiGDGdgzrK-FDeC41cxp0LPkbklbb-Al0VqkeS0tfdZclptqN5MEwmTOlw41dBsykyPq6FEiSmvCDfeBNBPQi2FzM_pCb_0q8I_RAX7mCfEl6T1jMrhXQHB3jlWtoAeepwjLmLWIUWYGDe)

Fellow Conservative,

_The New York Times_ is writing a story filled with frivolous lies about my childhood.

If it weren't so demeaning to my parents' lifelong teaching careers and the town I'm so proud to have been raised in, it might be funny.

The simple fact is _The New York Times_ is lying.

**Here's the truth: and I hope you will read all the way to the end. **

Growing up, we lived on campus at Bloomsburg State College and my parents owned a farm ten minutes down the road.

I had summer jobs baling hay and trimming Christmas trees at nearby farms.

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=12351d47df0244b3be4aa54e0c7492d2&_e=LgDdj1VaGZ40jR7EzFktitt2wNHKkSqv3J4DII_jpZcllJ-FegsjONQKl1tZDQTy_RlL6gevK5_oxbZnn7gbdbV-R3xmwrhQPZwy5732sUym4PYoVhBuHeb50ktcJdacOv4n-G8XCSSvGTyoZUxbRXi10GHYT7fMMIrvAQonqJ7JLSs8TMRmZ6ge7ILquFnL5kESu7ytzijmk4AT3i3WZUcPpTNW7ZHglzO82P3JTXL5qNdBjbYANAiVzm6xZHledYk_Q9I3n93igRIDcAp432y0MPk0oA20E5QyXUVlVKD1iGT_HrgRF-VlxcadxfzuyisVU7tgs0nKVgyFyB5TRebVgHa7TIbguArlAqxLHOwU83T6BYkz-6ziicZcsV_K)

My dad started his career teaching history, economics, & democracy at Punxsutawney High. My mom began teaching fourth through sixth graders at a public school near Pittsburgh.

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=12351d47df0244b3be4aa54e0c7492d2&_e=LgDdj1VaGZ40jR7EzFktitt2wNHKkSqv3J4DII_jpZcllJ-FegsjONQKl1tZDQTy_RlL6gevK5_oxbZnn7gbdbV-R3xmwrhQPZwy5732sUym4PYoVhBuHeb50ktcJdacOv4n-G8XCSSvGTyoZUxbRXi10GHYT7fMMIrvAQonqJ7JLSs8TMRmZ6ge7ILquFnL5kESu7ytzijmk4AT3i3WZUcPpTNW7ZHglzO82P3JTXKuIRLnh0UUJsk71MdKob-iDy2bVpmbnEXXlWCKh5LGASP_oR-XqIdkzXiV1bk2SZp1KrKBA8CtspnIEcPFi_3yh5wyXiydXIYQpiM6unW0jFLdJZZSNDPYVKHbQG1LZVjdgH3dyaFpSsBS_JZPuEva)

I'm incredibly proud that my dad was chosen to be president of Bloomsburg State College (now Bloomsburg State University) at only 34 years old.

[](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=12351d47df0244b3be4aa54e0c7492d2&_e=LgDdj1VaGZ40jR7EzFktitt2wNHKkSqv3J4DII_jpZcllJ-FegsjONQKl1tZDQTy_RlL6gevK5_oxbZnn7gbdbV-R3xmwrhQPZwy5732sUym4PYoVhBuHeb50ktcJdacOv4n-G8XCSSvGTyoZUxbRXi10GHYT7fMMIrvAQonqJ7JLSs8TMRmZ6ge7ILquFnL5kESu7ytzijmk4AT3i3WZUcPpTNW7ZHglzO82P3JTXLnLUoLQNoZK0ivgqiZ12Fip0z617gNm-PqpoP0jrBsXUiFI1imgbaRMNLRZ_CraMg2IFmiOdUAgZitJBcWuhRk4yqzosafeaIvr1RWa21OMgs-4P4XLGqkTXy37sgYuboBxgX2SA-rljjqfwRrkEP_)
It's incredible to me that this New York Times reporter somehow thinks this fact makes my dad "politically connected." **Does she know I 'm running against a career politician who's been riding his father's political coattails in elected office for three decades?**

And honestly, I've never looked back.
